title: Remote Manager (Director) Partnerships DACH (m/f/d)
description:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates. 

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation. 

The Role 

The goal of this role is pipeline revenue, driven through relationships. The Partner BDM is where the global partnership strategy meets the market, and you own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed that number. Every relationship, every lead, every partner conversation in your territory goes through you. You execute all three partnership pillars locally — integration depth, reseller acquisition, and long tail activation — and you feed the national programs run by Isabel and the Director of Reseller Partnerships with the contacts, intelligence, and HubSpot discipline that makes those programs possible.

This role also carries a global partner management component. In addition to your regional territory, you will be assigned one or two global partner accounts — relationships that span multiple BDM regions and require a consistent strategic, commercial presence above the regional level. You will manage these accounts directly, briefing with the Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior contact touchpoint and feeding back the account intelligence that informs RPG's global partner strategy.

The BDM is not a lone hunter. You are supported by intelligence briefs from the Director of Partnership Strategy, onboarding infrastructure from the Partner Operation and Enablement Manager, co-sell support from the Director of Channel Growth Reseller, and global account context from the Global Partner Marketing Manager. The discipline of using those inputs — requesting briefs before first calls, completing HubSpot fields that trigger Isabel's onboarding, registering every lead in Introw on the day — is what makes the whole system work.

Your Role 

Pipeline and revenue ownership — your region 

- Own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed this number, not just a contributor to it

- Build and maintain a consistent bottoms-up pipeline plan, built up against your region's targets and TAM — showing exactly how your book of business adds up to your target, by partner type and by deal stage

- Forecast monthly, ahead of the full-team KPR review — reforecasting pipeline and revenue coverage against target, reconciling to the latest refreshed regional targets/TAM where these have moved, so gaps are visible early and plans can be adjusted before target dates, not after

Regional partner development — all partner types 

- Build and manage the full partner portfolio in your territory: integration partners, resellers, consultants, hotel management companies, and referral partners

- Source new reseller and consultant contacts in your region — using the Ideal Reseller Partner Profile as the qualification standard

- Execute the partner conversation playbook for each contact type: open with the partner intelligence brief, use the CS manager and KAM conversation guides for integration partners, apply the reseller screening framework for agency contacts

- Request a partner intelligence brief from the Director Channel Growth - Integration before every first partner outreach — no first conversation without a brief

- Complete the 4 mandatory HubSpot fields (deal stage, partner fields, agreement file, partnership type) before advancing any deal past the signed stage — this triggers Isabel's onboarding program

- Register every qualified lead in Introw on the day it is received, tagged by source type (integration referral / reseller / consultant / reactivated dormant)

Global Partner Account Management 

- Own one or two assigned global partner accounts — relationships where the partner operates across multiple BDM territories and requires consistent commercial management above the regional level

- Build the regional strategy for each assigned global account that generates pipeline — not just relationship maintenance; you are responsible for identifying where the pipeline comes from in your territory and driving it

- Coordinate with Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior touchpoint at a global partner account — global commercial context will be provided; you provide the regional relationship intelligence

- Maintain the account relationship at the appropriate contact levels (sales, CS, KAM, implementation) — applying the multi-level engagement model from the Partner Activation Playbook

- Feed the Head of Global Partnerships and the Global Partner Marketing Manager with global account intelligence after every significant touchpoint — health signals, competitive intelligence, co-marketing opportunities, and any escalation requirements

- Support the coordination of co-marketing and QBR activity with the global partner where it involves your region

Long Tail Activation — Regional subset 

- Own your regional subset of the 272 dormant signed partners — the Director Channel Growth - Reseller & Consultant,provides the segmented list, you own the outreach

- Execute the tiered re-engagement approach: Tier 1 (60–90 days dormant) with a personalized message within the first week of assignment; Tier 2 with re-qualification before any effort; Tier 3 with a single attempt then escalation to Isabel to archive

- Report progress on your regional dormant subset to Isabel weekly during the H2 activation sprint

Market intelligence and HubSpot discipline 

- Surface partner contacts and market intelligence to the Reseller PM in the bi-weekly regional intel exchange — which reseller types are gaining traction, which are declining, what competitive signals are emerging

- Flag any integration partner conversation where an all-in-one competitive angle appears — the Strategy Manager updates the competitive library with field intelligence

- Maintain HubSpot contact and deal records at the expected quality standard — the data in HubSpot is what the whole team uses to run the business; poor data quality breaks Isabel's onboarding, Isabel's dormancy tracking, and Introw attribution simultaneously

- Participate in the monthly full-team KPR review — presenting your regional lead pipeline and flagging any structural blockers

Your Profile 

- 2+ years in a B2B business development, partnerships, or commercial account management role — ideally in SaaS, hospitality technology, or a related field

- Demonstrates advanced proficiency in German (C2 level), with excellent command of both

- Track record of building relationships and generating pipeline from scratch in a defined territory — not managing inbound, but generating outbound

- Comfortable operating across multiple partner types and conversation styles in a single week — integration partnership conversations require a different approach than reseller qualification

- HubSpot or CRM discipline — this is a non-negotiable requirement; the quality of your data determines the quality of the team's output

- Based in the target territory — regional credibility and proximity to local partners is part of the role

Nice to Have 

- Existing network in the hotel technology ecosystem (PMS, channel manager, consultants, or revenue management) in the relevant territory

- Experience managing global or multi-territory accounts in addition to a local territory portfolio

- Familiarity with Introw, PartnerStack, Reditus, or similar partner and commission tracking platforms

- Revenue management or hospitality operations background — understanding how an independent hotel owner thinks is a genuine advantage in partner conversations

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together. 

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

- Remote-First Model : Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

- One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

- Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

- Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

- 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

- Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

- Flexible Hours: We get it—life happens! ⏰ We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your work and personal life seamlessly.

- Wellbeing Matters: Your mental health is a top priority. 🧘 Every Genie gets access to Headspace, the leading meditation app, to help you cultivate a happier, healthier, and more zen life. 🌿

- BetterHelp Support: We also offer BetterHelp , a professional online therapy and counseling platform, giving you additional support whenever you need it. 💛🧠 

We kindly ask that recruitment agencies refrain from reaching out regarding this vacancy. Thank you for your understanding.

title: Growth Lead (m/f/d)
description:
About viral.app

viral.app is the software brands and agencies use to run UGC marketing at scale. It helps to hire creators, track every video on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and Snapchat, and pay creators based on performance.

So far the founders have run marketing alongside everything else: SEO and content, free tools, our newsletter The FYP Leak, Google Ads, and posts on LinkedIn and X. Tracking and a lot of the scrappy growth work already run on AI automations we built ourselves. We're hiring a Growth Lead for the channels and content that don't automate well and need skill and taste.

This is a hands-on role. You set the plan and do most of the work together with the founders.

Your tasks

- Own growth end to end: the plan, the budget and the execution.

- Build a niche audience around creator marketing on LinkedIn and X under your own name. If you already have one, bring it. If you don't, you're motivated to build it from zero.

- Create the content formats that are hard to automate, for example short-form video, customer stories, founder-led posts and deep dives on what makes UGC perform.

- Test and run any channel that could bring us customers, for example LinkedIn, X, YouTube, cold email, Google Ads, Meta ads, organic content, AEO (getting cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews), Reddit, affiliate marketing and B2B creators. Spend most of your time on the channels where quality beats volume.

- For paid channels, run the ad accounts yourself: targeting, copy, creative briefs and budget.

- Run experiments every week. Measure them against signups, trials and revenue, and keep what works.

- Work with the founders and engineering on positioning, launches, onboarding and pricing pages.

- Bring in freelancers or agencies where they're faster, and help build a growth team as we grow.

What success looks like after 90 days

- You've launched at least two content formats we couldn't have automated, and our audience shares them.

- You've found at least one organic and one paid channel that bring in signups week after week.

- You post on LinkedIn and X every week, and your audience in creator marketing is growing.

- Experiments ship every week, and each one ends with a written result.

- We have a growth plan for the next six months that you wrote and own.

Your profile

- About 3 years in B2B SaaS growth or marketing, with results you can show in numbers: signups, pipeline or ARR. Fewer years are fine if your results stand out.

- You've grown a B2B SaaS product through organic channels such as SEO, content, community or product-led loops, and you did much of that work yourself.

- You've run paid acquisition for B2B SaaS from inside the ad accounts. You know what CAC and payback should look like for a self-serve plan compared with a sales-assisted deal.

- You've owned several channels at once, from first idea to live campaign to reporting.

- You move fast. You'd rather ship five small tests this week than one perfect campaign next quarter.

- You're scrappy. You write the landing page, build the campaign and pull the numbers yourself, and you know where AI saves time and where it hurts quality.

- You have taste. You can tell a post, video or landing page that will land from one that won't, and you can make the good one yourself.

- Fluent English. German is a plus.

Nice to have 

- An existing audience of marketers, founders or creators on LinkedIn or X

- Experience with creator, UGC or influencer marketing, or with selling to performance marketers and agencies

- Early-stage startup experience, ideally as the first marketing or growth hire

- You've used free tools or data reports as a growth channel

What we offer

- You own growth and report directly to the CEO.

- €40,000–80,000 per year, depending on experience. Virtual stock options (VSOP) are possible for the right person.

- A budget for ads and tools.

- Fully remote from anywhere in a European time zone, with in-person team meetups several times a year.

- Short decision paths. If a test makes sense, you can run it the same week.

How to apply

Apply with your CV and answer four short questions. Add links to real work in your application: pages you ranked, campaigns, dashboards or writing. They tell us more than a cover letter.

- Flexibilität: Du arbeitest gerne im Team und behältst auch bei viel Trubel im Store einen kühlen Kopf und dein Lächeln.

- Sprachen: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Englischkenntnisse sind ein großes Plus, damit du auch unsere internationalen Kund:innen perfekt beraten kannst.

- Weitere Vergünstigungen: Tolle Rabatte in unserem Online-Shop sowie bei Partnerunternehmen, coole Teamevents & Firmenfeiern.

flaconi ist einer der führenden deutschen Online-Kosmetikhändler mit einem umfangreichen Portfolio von fast 1000 Marken und 50.000 Produkten. description:

We are seeking a (Senior) Data Scientist (all genders) to join a dynamic team of five within our DATA department. You'll dive into diverse challenges including training and deploying machine learning models, developing Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, and statistical modeling. We believe in flat hierarchies, which means you'll work closely with colleagues of various seniorities in a fun environment. You'll play a key role in extracting valuable insights and developing data and AI solutions to optimize our e-commerce platform across Europe, taking end-to-end ownership of your projects and collaborating closely with business stakeholders along the way. Your contributions will have a direct impact on business decisions and process efficiency across a wide spectrum of unique use cases.

Your Role

- Employ statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms for regression, classification, and clustering (e.g., Gradient Boosting, Random Forest, Hierarchical Clustering, ensemble methods).

- Develop and productionalize Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions alongside modern NLP techniques using transformer architectures (e.g., BERT, GPT).

- Utilize time-series forecasting methods (e.g., ARIMA, LSTM, DeepAR, Prophet) for predictive modeling.

- Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA), advanced feature engineering, and dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE).

- Develop and implement deep learning models in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras while leveraging transfer learning strategies.

- Showcase your skills across key e-commerce data science use cases including demand forecasting, churn and CLTV modeling, pricing, customer segmentation, recommender systems, and personalization.

- Handle large-scale datasets using distributed computing frameworks (Apache Spark) on a tech stack comprising Python (PySpark, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, LightGBM), SQL, Databricks (Data Lakehouse & ML platform), AWS (S3, Lambda, EC2, SageMaker, Bedrock), GitHub, and AI-augmented tools (Claude, Copilot) while collaborating directly to proactively address stakeholder business needs.

Your Profile

- Bring a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in developing and deploying machine learning solutions for real-world business problems.

- Demonstrate background exposure to e-commerce (ideal) , fintech , or fast-paced agency environments.

- Demonstrate hands-on experience with Databricks as a Data & AI platform (required) alongside cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

- Prove hands-on experience in building, productionalizing, and deploying Generative AI or Agentic AI solutions.

- Apply hands-on experience with MLOps practices and tools (required) for end-to-end model lifecycle management.

- Possess a strong grasp of core data science principles to select the most appropriate techniques, combined with advanced proficiency in SQL, Python (PySpark, scikit-learn, NumPy, matplotlib, pandas), and AI-augmented development tools (Claude, Copilot).

- Communicate exceptionally in English (written and verbal) to articulate complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders, driving projects with full end-to-end ownership as a collaborative team player.

What We Offer 

- Our employees matter to us : We offer you a permanent contract and cover the costs for your Deutschland ticket.

- Work-life balance : 29 vacation days plus additional days off on the 24th and 31st December, flexible working hours, up to three days of working from home per week, working abroad options, paid sabbatical.

- flaconi Academy : Actively shape your own career path by taking advantage of our internal and external training opportunities.

- We care about your well being : We want to support you also during difficult times. For this, we offer you and your close relatives counseling sessions with mental health professionals.

- flaconi fitness : a wide range of sports options & discounts on memberships.

- Family first: Our “emergency-daycare” is there for you in out-of-the-ordinary situations to look after your child on site at our office.

- Thinking about tomorrow together : flaconi subsidizes your savings contribution to the company pension scheme with an additional 20%.

- A comfortable working space with everything you need : High end technical equipment, fruits and drinks, no dress code and dogs are welcome in our office!

- Other perks : Great discounts in our online shop as well with our partner companies, cool team events & company parties!

title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
description:
Mozilla Foundation is a non-profit building a better technology future — powered by people, open by design, fueled by imagination. 

We deliver people-first alternatives to today’s extractive systems. We build side by side with developers, innovators and advocates, united in the belief that a better technology future is not only possible — it’s ours to create! 

Team 

Our CEO is increasingly focused outward on the Board, funders, partners, and public conversations that will shape the Foundation’s next chapter. This newly created Chief of Staff role exists to extend the CEO’s reach inside the organization and make that outward focus possible. 

Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll serve as the CEO’s strategic partner, internal proxy and trusted extension of their leadership. You’ll hold the CEO’s strategic agenda, translate the CEO’s priorities into organizational alignment, represent the CEO internally where needed, and make decisions on the CEO’s behalf within clearly delegated authority. You’ll determine what reaches the CEO, prepare the CEO for consequential moments, and escalate only what requires the CEO’s judgment. 

As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, you’ll partner strategically with other members of the ELT and work closely with the CEO’s Executive Program Manager to make sure the CEO’s time, priorities, and commitments stay aligned and moving. 

You’ll also partner with the Foundation’s Investment Committee and its technical and strategic advisors, keeping their focus on the right questions, their recommendations aligned with the Foundation’s strategic priorities, and decisions moving efficiently from evaluation to funding. 

Job responsibilities 

Here’s what you’ll likely be focused on for the first 6 months : 

- Building a strong working partnership with the CEO, aligning on priorities, ways of working and clearly defining the scope of your delegated authority. 

- Establishing a trusted partnership with each member of the Executive Leadership Team, learning their priorities, pressures and ways of working. 

- Developing a deep, cross-functional understanding of the Foundation’s work and how each function connects to the CEO’s priorities. 

- Translating the CEO’s priorities into a concise, clear set of strategic outcomes that leaders understand and can use to guide the decisions they own, with a current view of what’s changing and which decisions are approaching. 

- Defining with the CEO what truly requires their attention, and ensuring issues reach them decision-ready, with context, options and a recommendation. 

- Getting up to speed with the Investment Committee and its advisors, and helping keep their focus on the right questions so decisions move efficiently from evaluation to funding. 

As the Chief of Staff to Mozilla Foundation’s CEO, you will… 

- Serve as the CEO’s thought partner in developing, pressure-testing and refining strategic priorities, synthesizing executive insight and external developments to anticipate what will need to be known or decided in the next 30, 60 and 90 days. 

- Direct the CEO’s time toward strategy, external relationships, development, Board leadership and the Foundation’s highest-consequence decisions. 

- Filter rather than forward, so significant shifts in strategy, material risks, major budget decisions and Board-level matters reach the CEO early, with context, options and a recommendation. 

- Maintain a current view of the CEO’s top priorities, identify where work is drifting from strategic intent, and surface conflicts in priorities, resources or attention before they become emergencies. 

- Enable the Executive Leadership Team to operate as one team around the CEO’s priorities, so the right issues reach the ELT at the right level and decisions and commitments are followed through. 

- Partner with ELT members on cross-functional issues that need CEO-level alignment but not the CEO’s direct involvement. 

- Represent the CEO’s position in internal discussions and make decisions on the CEO’s behalf within delegated authority, bringing anything beyond it back to the CEO promptly. 

- Ensure the CEO enters every Board meeting, funder and partner conversation, speech and public engagement fully prepared, with concise briefings, organizational context and answers to likely questions. 

- Identify external opportunities that warrant the CEO’s attention, and ensure commitments the CEO makes externally translate into clear internal follow-through. 

- Steward alignment between the Investment Committee’s work and the Foundation’s strategy: keep its technical and strategic advisors focused on the right questions, surface gaps, risks or competing views, and bring forward matters that need the CEO’s judgment. 

What this role is not 

This is a role of influence. It exists to ensure the CEO can lead effectively through the Executive Leadership Team. 

- The Chief of Staff does not manage the Executive Leadership Team or run the Foundation’s operations. Each executive leader owns execution and decisions within their area. 

- This role does not make decisions beyond the authority the CEO has delegated. Anything outside that authority returns to the CEO. 

- This role does not have any direct reports and also doesn’t manage the CEO’s calendar, scheduling or administrative support. 

Your Professional Profile 

- Significant, verifiable experience as a strategic partner at CEO or executive-team level, with a track record of leading high-stakes work and turning ambiguity into structure and action. 

- Experience working across multiple legal entities is a plus, including navigating differences, building influence, and coordinating work across entities where relevant. 

- A proven record of driving complex, cross-functional priorities from idea to execution by defining outcomes, ownership, milestones and decision points. 

- Exceptional judgment and discretion, including handling confidential information and navigating complex executive dynamics with integrity. 

- Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, build trust across functions and at the most senior levels, and give direct feedback with care. 

- Outstanding written and verbal communication, with experience distilling complex information into decision-ready briefs, recommendations, presentations and executive communications. 

- Strong analytical and strategic problem-solving skills: you frame the right question, gather the right information, test assumptions and recommend a practical path forward. 

- Disciplined prioritization, with the agility to move between long-term priorities and time-sensitive issues without losing the thread. 

- Direct experience supporting Board governance, fundraising or other high-stakes external relationships at an executive level. 

- A track record of doing high-impact work out of the spotlight, measuring your success by the CEO’s and the team’s, and acting in the best interests of the CEO and the organization. 

- A demonstrated commitment to Mozilla Foundation’s mission and to building an open, accessible and trustworthy internet. 

- The ability to work across time zones and occasionally outside standard working hours for Board meetings, major events or urgent organizational needs. 

- Comfortable traveling for Board meetings, leadership gatherings and major events. 

We Are Excited To See Any Additional Experience With: 

- Senior roles in nonprofit, philanthropic, technology or public-interest organizations. 

- Supporting or advising investment, grantmaking or funding committees. 

How We Work 

A few things that are true about how we work at Mozilla Foundation. Here's a summary along with our expectation of how these should show up in this role: 

- Move toward the hard thing : you surface conflicts in priorities, resources or attention early, and give the CEO and executives direct, actionable input, including what they may not want to hear. You disagree constructively in the room, not afterward, and you don’t wait for someone else to raise it.

- Stay curious and current : you stay close to what executives are seeing and what’s happening in our fields and communities, and turn it into the context the CEO needs. You pressure-test assumptions, including your own.

- Work in the open : you document decisions and the reasoning behind them, so executives and teams can follow how and why priorities are set. You favor shared channels over side conversations wherever appropriate.

- Focus and finish : you keep the CEO’s agenda focused on what matters most, make deliberate choices about what does and doesn’t need the CEO, and make sure decisions and commitments are seen through.

- Flex with purpose : you move between long-term priorities and time-sensitive issues as context shifts, and adapt how you work with each executive. Flexibility isn’t about being agreeable; it’s staying responsive while holding to the mission and the CEO’s priorities.

- Lead with care : you hold a high bar for the work while treating people as whole humans. You extend good faith to fellow executives, respect that each owns their area, and talk directly to the person who can solve the problem.

Salary and Benefits Information 

Mozilla Foundation is dedicated to fair and equitable compensation for our staff. We aim to pay a competitive and market-based salary based on the responsibilities and requirements of the role. We do not ask for, or take into account, salary histories in our offer process.

The starting salary ranges for this role are listed below. 

- Germany: €206,448.00 – €232,253.22

- UK: £181,764.00 – £204,483.81

- Canada: $356,400.00 – $400,948.65

- US: $264,000.00 – $296,999.00

We also offer the following benefits:

- Private Medical Insurance

- Extended Sick Leave

- Global Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

- Retirement Plan contributions

- Paid Time Off: 20 days annual leave + sick days and your birthday

- Company Holidays + EOY Shutdown

- Wellness budget

- Professional Development budget

- Top up program for Pregnancy and Parental leaves

Benefits are subject to change at any time at the discretion of Mozilla Foundation. 

Mozilla Foundation Hiring Practices 

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities and expressions.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Security Engineer
description:
ÜBER UNSERE COMPANY 

freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”.

In mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten haben wir immer das ausgeliefert, was wir versprochen haben – “always on time, on budget, on target and on quality”.

85% unserer Members sind Software Engineers mit Abschlüssen in Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik, viele auch mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Maschinellem Lernen und Künstlicher Intelligenz. 

Seit über einem Vierteljahrhundert arbeiten wir für das „Who’s Who“ der deutschen und europäischen Industrie- und Handelsunternehmen. 
Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr.

Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz. 

Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”. 

Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat.

Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein.

Technology never rests. Neither do we.

ÜBER DEINEN JOB 

- Wir sind der festen Überzeugung, dass Sicherheit ein technisches Thema ist. Deshalb glauben wir, dass nur ein echter Engineer für die Sicherheit bei freiheit.com verantwortlich sein kann. Nur wenn Du weißt, wie die Dinge funktionieren, kannst Du Prozesse und Richtlinien entwerfen, um uns und unsere Daten sicher und geschützt zu halten.

- Du entwirfst und implementierst die Infrastruktur, damit Du einfache, aber dennoch zuverlässige und sichere Prozesse sowie Richtlinien einführen kannst.

- Da Du von Herzen Engineer bist, schreibst Du Code, um manuelle Aufgaben zu automatisieren. Du weißt sowieso, dass es der einzige Weg ist.

- Du bist aber auch für unser ISMS (Information Security Management System) verantwortlich und sorgst dafür, dass dieses stets auf dem neuesten Stand ist und die Regeln und Vorschriften im ISMS sinnvoll und hilfreich sind. Ebenso arbeitest Du mit unserem Datenschutzbeauftragten zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass wir die DSGVO einhalten.

- Du stärkst unsere Mitglieder auch, indem Du ihnen Sicherheit beibringst. Sowohl durch die Gestaltung von Schulungen als auch durch die Unterstützung bei der Schaffung einer sicheren Infrastruktur in ihren Projekten.

- Das Jobprofil ist eine tolle Chance für Software Engineers, die ihr Spektrum in Richtung Sicherheit und Compliance erweitern und zudem strategisch arbeiten möchten.

- Wir glauben auch, dass eine kleine Dosis Zwangsstörung hilfreich sein könnte ;-). Zumindest solltest Du den starken Willen haben, die Dinge richtig zu machen, und sehr sorgfältig bei Deiner Arbeit sein.

ÜBER DICH 
Qualifikationen: 

- Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik oder verwandten Bereichen wie Mathematik, Physik oder Elektrotechnik

- Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes

- Erfahrung in der UNIX-Systemadministration und Networking

- Programmiererfahrung – idealerweise in Go

- Hoher Einfluss auf den technischen Erfolg Deiner vergangenen Projekte

- Die Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen

- Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mind. C1) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. 

Bonus Skills and Interessen: 

- Master oder Doktortitel in Informatik oder verwandten Bereichen wie Mathematik oder Physik

- Erfahrung in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS) oder Microsoft Azure

- Erfahrung mit Observability (Protokollierung, Überwachung, Alarmierung, Rückverfolgung)

- Erfahrung mit Security

- Erfahrung im Umgang mit verteilten Systemen in der Cloud (Terraform)

- Erfahrung im Einrichten von CI/CD-Pipelines

ÜBER UNSERE COMMUNITY 

Auf die Frage, warum jemand hier arbeitet, lautet die Antwort oft: „wegen der Menschen“ und „weil ich in meinem Leben noch nie so viel gelernt habe“.

Wir glauben, dass produktive Menschen glückliche Menschen sind. 

In unseren Engineering Hubs in Hamburg und Lissabon triffst du auf Menschen aus der ganzen Welt. 

Hier hast du die Möglichkeit, mit intelligenten Menschen an spannenden Aufgaben zu arbeiten und Projekte von der Idee bis zur Auslieferung umzusetzen – end-to-end. 

Ein wahrer Experte in seinem Fachgebiet wird man nicht über Nacht – dazu braucht es Jahre harter Arbeit und kontinuierliches Lernen. Als ein Member unserer Community wird viel von dir verlangt, und niemand kann die Arbeit für dich übernehmen.

Unser Unternehmen ist ein Ort, an dem du die beste Version deiner selbst werden kannst. 

***Wir bieten keine reinen Remote-Stellen an. Wir arbeiten fünf Tage pro Woche im Büro. 

DAZUGEHÖREN? 

Dann schicke uns Deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse) über unser Bewerberportal. Und bei Fragen zu Deiner Bewerbung oder dem Bewerbungsprozess steht Dir Bianca Mioc unter +49 40/890584-0 persönlich zur Verfügung.

title: Account Executive DACH - SMB (m/f/d)
description:
About Agicap 

Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.

Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.

We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024.

These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.

We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure!

Home page 

Customer Stories 

Our Values 

About the Account Executive - SMB role:

We are growing our team in Düsseldorf! Working closely with the Business Development team, Outbound SDRs, Inbound SDRs and Partnership Managers on a daily basis, your mission will be to generate new business by acquiring new clients.

As an SMB Account Executive at Agicap, you will drive sales and expand our customer base within the SMB segment. You will play a crucial role in identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with potential clients and closing deals in order to achieve your sales targets.

You will be responsible for: 

- Defining and implementing a sectoral development strategy with your SDRs.

- Identifying and targeting SMB companies that could benefit from Agicap’s financial management solutions.

- Conducting product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the value of Agicap’s offerings.

- Developing and maintaining a robust sales pipeline through prospecting, networking, and referrals.

- Building and nurturing relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within target organizations.

- Negotiating contracts and closing sales to meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.

- Staying informed about industry developments, competitor activities, and market trends.

- Regularly monitoring and analyzing your performance with Management to identify areas for improvement.

- Providing feedback to the Marketing, Business Development, and Product teams to improve processes and the product.

- Sharing your commercial expertise and good ideas to enhance the team’s performance.

What we are looking for: 

- Native/Bilingual level of German

- 2-4 years of experience in B2B Sales, preferably in the SaaS industry and with mid-market space, and with some experience working in a finance department/audit/consulting/TS.

- Studies background in a top business or Engineering school.

- A passion for sales and a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets.

- A tenacious, resilient salesperson who never gives up and is driven by results.

- Someone who can put themselves in the shoes of business leaders to understand their current and future cash flow needs.

- Strong analytical and synthesis skills, excellent verbal communication, and a high level of intellectual curiosity.

- Great ambition, with the drive to meet and even exceed objectives.

- A strong business acumen and above-average interpersonal skills.

- A team spirit and a desire to share knowledge, helping colleagues grow.

7 Reasons to Join Agicap as an AE: 

- Exceptional product-market fit, confirmed by our latest funding round:

- Crucial need → cash = the lifeblood of business, top priority for CFOs (PwC)

- Strongly differentiated solution, leader in Europe (G2)

- Gigantic market: over 350k companies in DACH alone

- Unique company culture: meritocracy, high standards, continuous learning, European scale-up (>50% revenue outside France)

- Opportunities for functional and geographical growth

- Strong financial situation

- Team of rockstars, friendly and skilled

- A growth engine of a large Outbound SDR team, Inbound & Partner leads to help you scale fast!

- Competitive package - with uncapped commissions!

Our benefits: 
- Competitive Compensation: Attractive package including both fixed and variable components.

- Professional Development: Access a “Mini-MBA” with a focus on Finance & Treasury via the Agicap Academy.

- Global Collaboration: Join a diverse international team with occasional trips to our headquarters in France.

- Meal & Grocery Allowance: Receive up to €108/month tax-free for lunch or groceries, easily managed via the Hrmony app.

- Tenure Rewards: Enjoy a €30 monthly shopping voucher after one year and up to two additional vacation days based on your length of service.

- Team culture: Join us and be part of a dynamic environment, enjoying global offsites such as our recent annual seminar on a French island, as well as local team events.

AGICAP is committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone, and we foster an inclusive work environment that values diversity!

title: MS Dynamics Senior Functional Manager
description:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry? 

We are Emma – The Sleep Company . Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe.  

Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide.  

It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together.  

Ready to awaken your best with us? 

We are looking for a passionate, highly motivated Senior MS Dynamics Functional Manager to help shape and scale our Finance and Supply Chain systems, working hands-on across the ERP landscape to turn business needs into robust, maintainable ERP solution. 

What you'll do: 

- Collaborate with the team & stakeholders to gather and validate requirements across the Finance and Supply Chain domains (R2R, O2C, P2P).  

- Analyze business processes and contribute to the design of ERP solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business goals. 

- Translate business needs into clear functional specifications and configuration inputs.

- Ensure that functional deliverables meet quality standards and align with ERP configuration best practices. 

- Produce clear and comprehensive documentation of future-state business processes to support solution design, stakeholder alignment, and long-term maintainability.   

- Perform functional testing of developed features and support go-live readiness activities, including user training, documentation, and post-deployment validation.  

- Identify and recommend opportunities for continuous improvement in business processes and system usage.

What we're looking for: 

- Hands-on experience in ERP systems, with strong functional expertise in one or more of the following domains: Record to Report (R2R), Order to Cash (O2C), or Procure to Pay (P2P).   

- Previous experience working with Microsoft Dynamics (either Business Central or Finance & Operations) is a must. 

- Proven ability to gather and analyse business requirements and translate them into effective ERP configurations and process improvements. 

- Skilled in documenting business processes and functional designs in a clear, structured, and maintainable format 

- Experience in functional testing, including test case creation and validation of system behavior. 

- Comfortable working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments and actively participating in ceremonies such as planning, reviews, and retrospectives. 

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to tailor the speech according to the audience to work effectively across cross-functional business and technical teams. 

- Detail-oriented and quality-focused, with a commitment to delivering consistent, high-standard functional outputs. 

- Professional fluency in English. 

What we offer: 

- Maturing Scale-Up : We’re part of the 13–20% of start-ups that transition to scale-up. This is a rare stage where we refine systems without losing agility. It’s where start-up energy meets scalable impact - and where people can build the next version of Emma.

- Empowerment to Impact : Every Emmie owns part of our success with accountability. It’s about seeing it, owning it, doing it – something that is valued and measured in development.

- Growth & Learning Journey : We live by the 70/20/10 model – with 70% on the job, 20% from others, 10% structured training. We invest in your growth with trainings and coaching to get you to the top of your game.

- Emma-zing Community : We hire selectively which means working with smart, collaborative people who care deeply. It’s a community built by Emmies for Emmies.

- Next Level Global : With 60+ nationalities across 4 offices, global collaboration is part of our values. You’ll work across cultures, perspectives, and time zones.

- Flexibility : Our Technology team's remote work policy allows for great flexibility. (Please note that the role requires being based in Portugal or Germany) 

Become an Emmie 

We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.  

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age. 

Our aim is to get back to you within a few days. Due to the high volume of applications, there may be slight delays, but we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

title: Design Manager or Senior Design Manager - Norway (Stargate Norway - Narvik)
description:
About Us

At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for Europe’s AI revolution. Nscale are developing cutting-edge sovereign generative AI solutions, powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centres and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads.

The growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Nscale is positioned at the heart of this transformation — building the platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation.

Nscale are working closely with the world’s most advanced AI technology providers, integrating next-gen compute hardware and GPU clusters in both partner and Nscale built facilities. This is an opportunity to join Nscale’s journey, play a key role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company designed to scale rapidly across Europe and beyond.

The Role 

The Design Manager will be based on-site in Narvik and will oversee the design process throughout delivery of the Stargate Norway initiative. The position is essential in ensuring the design process enables our facilities to be built to world-class technical standards, delivered on schedule, to budget, and adaptable to the rapidly evolving needs of AI compute. title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
description:
Mozilla Foundation is a non-profit building a better technology future — powered by people, open by design, fueled by imagination. 

We deliver people-first alternatives to today’s extractive systems. We build side by side with developers, innovators and advocates, united in the belief that a better technology future is not only possible — it’s ours to create! 

Team 

Our CEO is increasingly focused outward on the Board, funders, partners, and public conversations that will shape the Foundation’s next chapter. This newly created Chief of Staff role exists to extend the CEO’s reach inside the organization and make that outward focus possible. 

Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll serve as the CEO’s strategic partner, internal proxy and trusted extension of their leadership. You’ll hold the CEO’s strategic agenda, translate the CEO’s priorities into organizational alignment, represent the CEO internally where needed, and make decisions on the CEO’s behalf within clearly delegated authority. You’ll determine what reaches the CEO, prepare the CEO for consequential moments, and escalate only what requires the CEO’s judgment. 

As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, you’ll partner strategically with other members of the ELT and work closely with the CEO’s Executive Program Manager to make sure the CEO’s time, priorities, and commitments stay aligned and moving. 

You’ll also partner with the Foundation’s Investment Committee and its technical and strategic advisors, keeping their focus on the right questions, their recommendations aligned with the Foundation’s strategic priorities, and decisions moving efficiently from evaluation to funding. 

Job responsibilities 

Here’s what you’ll likely be focused on for the first 6 months : 

- Building a strong working partnership with the CEO, aligning on priorities, ways of working and clearly defining the scope of your delegated authority. 

- Establishing a trusted partnership with each member of the Executive Leadership Team, learning their priorities, pressures and ways of working. 

- Developing a deep, cross-functional understanding of the Foundation’s work and how each function connects to the CEO’s priorities. 

- Translating the CEO’s priorities into a concise, clear set of strategic outcomes that leaders understand and can use to guide the decisions they own, with a current view of what’s changing and which decisions are approaching. 

- Defining with the CEO what truly requires their attention, and ensuring issues reach them decision-ready, with context, options and a recommendation. 

- Getting up to speed with the Investment Committee and its advisors, and helping keep their focus on the right questions so decisions move efficiently from evaluation to funding. 

As the Chief of Staff to Mozilla Foundation’s CEO, you will… 

- Serve as the CEO’s thought partner in developing, pressure-testing and refining strategic priorities, synthesizing executive insight and external developments to anticipate what will need to be known or decided in the next 30, 60 and 90 days. 

- Direct the CEO’s time toward strategy, external relationships, development, Board leadership and the Foundation’s highest-consequence decisions. 

- Filter rather than forward, so significant shifts in strategy, material risks, major budget decisions and Board-level matters reach the CEO early, with context, options and a recommendation. 

- Maintain a current view of the CEO’s top priorities, identify where work is drifting from strategic intent, and surface conflicts in priorities, resources or attention before they become emergencies. 

- Enable the Executive Leadership Team to operate as one team around the CEO’s priorities, so the right issues reach the ELT at the right level and decisions and commitments are followed through. 

- Partner with ELT members on cross-functional issues that need CEO-level alignment but not the CEO’s direct involvement. 

- Represent the CEO’s position in internal discussions and make decisions on the CEO’s behalf within delegated authority, bringing anything beyond it back to the CEO promptly. 

- Ensure the CEO enters every Board meeting, funder and partner conversation, speech and public engagement fully prepared, with concise briefings, organizational context and answers to likely questions. 

- Identify external opportunities that warrant the CEO’s attention, and ensure commitments the CEO makes externally translate into clear internal follow-through. 

- Steward alignment between the Investment Committee’s work and the Foundation’s strategy: keep its technical and strategic advisors focused on the right questions, surface gaps, risks or competing views, and bring forward matters that need the CEO’s judgment. 

What this role is not 

This is a role of influence. It exists to ensure the CEO can lead effectively through the Executive Leadership Team. 

- The Chief of Staff does not manage the Executive Leadership Team or run the Foundation’s operations. Each executive leader owns execution and decisions within their area. 

- This role does not make decisions beyond the authority the CEO has delegated. Anything outside that authority returns to the CEO. 

- This role does not have any direct reports and also doesn’t manage the CEO’s calendar, scheduling or administrative support. 

Your Professional Profile 

- Significant, verifiable experience as a strategic partner at CEO or executive-team level, with a track record of leading high-stakes work and turning ambiguity into structure and action. 

- Experience working across multiple legal entities is a plus, including navigating differences, building influence, and coordinating work across entities where relevant. 

- A proven record of driving complex, cross-functional priorities from idea to execution by defining outcomes, ownership, milestones and decision points. 

- Exceptional judgment and discretion, including handling confidential information and navigating complex executive dynamics with integrity. 

- Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, build trust across functions and at the most senior levels, and give direct feedback with care. 

- Outstanding written and verbal communication, with experience distilling complex information into decision-ready briefs, recommendations, presentations and executive communications. 

- Strong analytical and strategic problem-solving skills: you frame the right question, gather the right information, test assumptions and recommend a practical path forward. 

- Disciplined prioritization, with the agility to move between long-term priorities and time-sensitive issues without losing the thread. 

- Direct experience supporting Board governance, fundraising or other high-stakes external relationships at an executive level. 

- A track record of doing high-impact work out of the spotlight, measuring your success by the CEO’s and the team’s, and acting in the best interests of the CEO and the organization. 

- A demonstrated commitment to Mozilla Foundation’s mission and to building an open, accessible and trustworthy internet. 

- The ability to work across time zones and occasionally outside standard working hours for Board meetings, major events or urgent organizational needs. 

- Comfortable traveling for Board meetings, leadership gatherings and major events. 

We Are Excited To See Any Additional Experience With: 

- Senior roles in nonprofit, philanthropic, technology or public-interest organizations. 

- Supporting or advising investment, grantmaking or funding committees. 

How We Work 

A few things that are true about how we work at Mozilla Foundation. Here's a summary along with our expectation of how these should show up in this role: 

- Move toward the hard thing : you surface conflicts in priorities, resources or attention early, and give the CEO and executives direct, actionable input, including what they may not want to hear. You disagree constructively in the room, not afterward, and you don’t wait for someone else to raise it.

- Stay curious and current : you stay close to what executives are seeing and what’s happening in our fields and communities, and turn it into the context the CEO needs. You pressure-test assumptions, including your own.

- Work in the open : you document decisions and the reasoning behind them, so executives and teams can follow how and why priorities are set. You favor shared channels over side conversations wherever appropriate.

- Focus and finish : you keep the CEO’s agenda focused on what matters most, make deliberate choices about what does and doesn’t need the CEO, and make sure decisions and commitments are seen through.

- Flex with purpose : you move between long-term priorities and time-sensitive issues as context shifts, and adapt how you work with each executive. Flexibility isn’t about being agreeable; it’s staying responsive while holding to the mission and the CEO’s priorities.

- Lead with care : you hold a high bar for the work while treating people as whole humans. You extend good faith to fellow executives, respect that each owns their area, and talk directly to the person who can solve the problem.

Salary and Benefits Information 

Mozilla Foundation is dedicated to fair and equitable compensation for our staff. We aim to pay a competitive and market-based salary based on the responsibilities and requirements of the role. We do not ask for, or take into account, salary histories in our offer process.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

- Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

- Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

- At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

- End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

- In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

- Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

- Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

- Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

- AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

- Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

What we look for

- A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

- Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

- High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

- Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

- Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

The role

We’re building the AI platform freight forwarders rely on. We started with quoting and are expanding across the shipment lifecycle. As Product Lead, you will be central to that expansion, helping decide where we focus and turning those decisions into products customers depend on.

What you’ll do: 

- Own product outcomes: Own the roadmap, priorities and performance of specific products, from defining the customer problem through launch, rollout and adoption. Partner with the founders on overall product direction and strategy.

- Build from customer insight: Work closely with freight forwarders across commercial and operational roles. Understand how they work, identify the problems customers share and build products for those needs rather than one-off solutions.

- Prototype and build: Turn ideas into working prototypes and early product versions, using AI tools and code to test them with customers. Work hands-on with engineering to take promising ideas into production, not just write specs and hand them over.

- Drive product expansion: Build a clear view of the market, including where we win, where we do not compete and why customers choose us. Use that understanding to identify the next workflows Nexcade should enter and turn them into products that grow revenue.

- Raise the standard of product thinking: Define success measures, test assumptions and examine accuracy, edge cases and second-order effects before scaling. Write clear specs and decision documents, including a written recommendation on the hard calls.

- Build the product operating system: Establish a clear planning and decision-making cadence without adding bureaucracy. Make sure product meetings are well prepared, teams have the context they need and decisions translate into shipped work.

- Make product and platform trade-offs: Work closely with engineering to decide when to invest in shared capabilities and when a faster, product-specific approach is right.

What we look for 

- Strong product judgement: You have owned meaningful product work in a complex B2B product and can show how your decisions changed customer behaviour or business results. You define success clearly and test assumptions, accuracy and edge cases before scaling.

- Product taste: You can turn complex workflows into products that feel simple, coherent and trustworthy. You care about the details that make people choose to use them.

- Technical fluency: You work effectively with strong engineers, understand trade-offs across architecture, AI, data and integrations and bring the customer and product perspective to choices about speed, quality and reuse.

- Excellent judgement: You get beyond what customers ask for to understand how their work really happens and distinguish repeatable needs from bespoke requests. You use customer and market insight to make product choices that drive adoption, expansion and revenue.

- High agency and directness: You take ownership, hold a high bar and disagree openly and constructively. You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration and changing priorities.

- Obsess over the problem: You are drawn to complex, messy problems in industries the economy depends on and want to understand how the people and systems behind them really work. Industry experience is a bonus, but not required.

Why join 

The biggest product choices are still ahead: how deep we go, where we expand and how everything fits together. Our product is already live with leading freight forwarders and this role will shape what comes next. You will build AI for the work that keeps global trade moving, alongside a team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will get meaningful equity in the company you help build.

title: Assistant Financial Controller
description:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

About the role

Reporting to Sarah Phillips, you’ll own month-end for Flock’s finance team and strengthen the controls around it, running the close and producing the variance analysis and MI that FP&A and our senior team use for budgeting and reporting. We’re automating finance on our new platform and the team uses AI every day, so there’s plenty of room to improve how the work gets done as well as doing it.

It suits a recently qualified accountant with strong core accounting from practice, who has already improved a process or control somewhere and wants to keep growing within the finance team.

What you’ll be doing

- Own the month-end close from start to finish so it lands accurately and on time.

- Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and post journals, keeping the ledger clean and well evidenced.

- Run variance analysis and build the monthly MI pack, explaining what moved and why.

- Strengthen our financial controls and automate manual steps wherever you find them.

- Prepare our VAT returns and assist with group reporting.

- Work with FP&A so the numbers behind budgets and senior reporting are right.

- Support the annual audit and work alongside our external auditors.

- Use AI tools in your daily work to speed up reconciliations, analysis and reporting, and share what works with the team.

- Pick up ad hoc finance projects, including R&D tax claims if you have the experience.

What you’ll need

- An ACA qualification, ideally recently qualified, although we’ll also consider strong ACCA or CIMA candidates.

- A practice background with hands-on month-end experience, whether from non-audit client work or time in industry. Big 4 or not makes no difference to us.

- Solid core accounting and close attention to detail, including balance sheet reconciliations, journals and variance analysis.

- Experience strengthening financial controls or improving a finance process, with an example you can talk us through.

- Curiosity and ambition, with the drive to push things forward and keep learning.

- An interest in AI. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should already be using it at work or in your own time and want to do more with it.

Nice to have:

- Audit experience.

- Experience using NetSuite.

- Experience automating finance processes.

- Exposure to R&D tax claims.

- Experience in the tech sector.

Benefits

- 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

- Share Incentive Plan 📈

- Workplace Pension 💰

- Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

- Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

- Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

- £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

- £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

- 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the role: 

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

- You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.

- You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.

- You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will: 

- Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.

- Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.

- Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention. 

- Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.

- Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.

- Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.

- Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.

- Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role. 

- 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.

- Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.

- Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.

- Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.

- Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.

- Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.

- Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.

- Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.

- Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.

- Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.

- Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.

- Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
