title: Senior Partner Growth Manager
description:
About Us 

We are Ocado Commercial, and we are revolutionising online grocery. We partner with the world's leading retailers, providing our innovative Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) – a powerful blend of automation and software – to elevate their e-commerce capabilities. Join us and be part of a team that's shaping the future of retail, working with global giants from Kroger to AEON. 

About the Role 

The Senior Partner Growth Manager role is an exciting opportunity in our Partner Success Team to directly influence the commercial success of our partners, some of the largest retailers in EMEA. This position will require reasonable travel to Saudi Arabia and/or Europe. 

Businesses that partner with Ocado come in all shapes and sizes, and leverage our technology in different ways. In this role, you will combine your knowledge of ecommerce, grocery retail, and online marketing with communication skills and analytical abilities to shape and influence how our partners grow online. 

The Partner Growth Manager will work with the Ocado Partner Account team to drive the growth agenda in our partner’s business, enabling our partners to improve commercial outcomes, grow their customer base, order volume, and overall profitability. 

You will build effective relationships with key commercial, marketing, and ecommerce stakeholders in our partners’ businesses. You will leverage knowledge of customer objectives, strategic know-how, knowledge of the Ocado Smart Platform (OSP), as well as the expertise of our central growth subject matter experts to create and implement successful growth strategies. You will become a first line of e-commerce growth support, leveraging our team of central subject matter experts for more in-depth support. You will support your internal stakeholders in the region with insights and reporting on growth topics, as well as be a source of information and support for your partners. 

As part of the Partner Success Team you will be responsible for supporting our partners in their day to day use of OSP, ensuring that their webshop is configured optimally, using the most impactful OSP features, to drive maximum customer acquisition, retention and basket size.

You will consult with partners through both in-depth projects in close collaboration with our Central Growth and/or Technology teams, as well as ongoing optimisation forums aimed at improving their commercial performance. You will leverage data to drive recommendations that improve overall performance. 

- The Partner Growth Manager is accountable for shaping and delivering growth strategy for their assigned Partner(s), supporting improved commercial outcomes including customer acquisition, retention, order growth and profitability.

- Works closely with the Partner’s ecommerce, marketing and technology teams and cross-functional Ocado stakeholders to align growth priorities and execution.

- Uses growth, trading and customer data and analytics to understand commercial performance, identify trends and opportunities, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations to Partners and internal stakeholders.

- Accountable for translating Partner growth objectives into clear, prioritised growth initiatives and optimisation opportunities that support long-term commercial success, maximising the potential of the OSP platform.

- Acts as Ocado’s primary growth and ecommerce subject matter expert for the Partner, using deep knowledge of OSP capabilities and growth / go-to-market expertise to shape recommendations on ecommerce configuration, trading, monetisation and customer experience, as well as sustainable marketing and communications adapted to the local competitive landscape

- Owns the Partner relationship for e-commerce and growth OSP roadmap engagement, acting as the named point of contact for, trading, monetisation, customer experience roadmap topic, and, in general, any non-operational topic.

- Represents Partner growth and ecommerce requirements and priorities into Ocado’s roadmap governance processes, supporting feature discovery with clear problem definition, context and Partner business case and value articulation.

- Monitors delivery and adoption of growth-critical features and capabilities, working with internal teams and Partners to maximise realised commercial value and improve utilisation of growth-enabling functionality.

- Identifies and escalates risks, dependencies or delivery issues that may impact the Partner’s ability to realise growth from OSP capabilities.

About you 

- Languages: Fluency in English is essential. Arabic and European languages are highly desirable.

- Bias to action, capable of designing data-driven strategies but also secure implementation

- Stakeholder, relationship building and networking skills

- A team player who’s comfortable interacting with Partner teams

- Self-motivated with an ability to deliver to deadlines and multi-task under pressure

- Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and uncertainty

- Able to handle difficult situations, facing challenges with positivity, confidence and pragmatism

- Experience in one or several of the following fields:

- Performance marketing within a direct to consumer business (grocery ecommerce experience a plus)

- Commercial or trading experience in a direct to consumer business ( grocery ecommerce experience a plus)

- Retail management consulting 

- Familiarity and passion for data-driven marketing, consumer insight, and ecommerce

- Familiarity with or experience with measuring and optimizing key growth metrics including user growth, conversion, LTV

What we offer 

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:

- Time to recharge :
25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.

- Health & wellbeing :
Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.

- Family-first policies :
22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave

- Financial support :
Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.

- Commuter perks :
Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.

title: Head of Alliances - Manager (F/H)
description:
Who We Are 

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Nous recrutons, pour renforcer nos équipes Sales, un.e Head of Alliances.

Missions 

En tant que Head of Alliances, vous pilotez le go-to-market de WPP Enterprise Solutions avec nos partenaires technologiques stratégiques (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify) et les innovateurs de l’IA. Point de convergence entre nos partenaires, nos équipes commerciales et nos Business Units, vous transformez la force de l’écosystème en pipeline, en différenciation et en croissance. Comme l’ensemble de l’équipe de Business Développement, vous reposez sur un profil hybride dont les 2 piliers sont d’être :

- Responsable du go-to-market conjoint avec nos partenaires technologiques stratégiques : co-construction des offres, des plans d’affaires et de la démarche de co-selling autour de nos capabilities auprès de clients et prospects,

- Orchestrateur de l’écosystème en interne : enablement des équipes, montée en compétence et certifications sur les plateformes partenaires, pour activer la bonne expertise au sein de WPP Enterprise Solutions et du réseau WPP

Cette hybridation est la clé du succès : être à la fois moteur du business généré via l’écosystème partenaires et garant de la capacité des équipes à délivrer avec ces technologies.

Dimension Business : 

- Définit et déploie la stratégie de go-to-market et de marketing partenaires de WPP Enterprise Solutions avec ses partenaires technologiques stratégiques, afin de maximiser la valeur, la différenciation et le pipeline générés par l’écosystème,

- Construit et anime les plans d’affaires conjoints (joint business plans) avec chaque partenaire clé (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), en pilotant objectifs, jalons et indicateurs de performance partagés,

- Orchestre le co-selling et le co-marketing : aligne partenaires, équipes commerciales et Business Units pour transformer les opportunités de l’écosystème en deals, du sourcing à la conversion,

- Conçoit et orchestre le plan d’événements dédiés ou co-construits avec les partenaires (webinaires, ateliers, salons, temps forts commerciaux), afin de générer visibilité, demande et pipeline,

- Met en œuvre, en continu, l’excellence de la démarche partenaires via les processus et outils internes ainsi que les portails partenaires, à des fins de visibilité, de pilotage et d’animation globale en interne,

- Sécurise et défend les intérêts économique et contractuel de WPP Enterprise Solutions dans le cadre des accords de partenariat (referral, reselling, MDF, niveaux de partenariat),

- Pilote le niveau de préférence et de mindshare de nos partenaires à notre égard : positionne WPP Enterprise Solutions comme partenaire de référence dans leur écosystème, fait progresser notre niveau de partenariat et suit la performance des objectifs conjoints,

- Contribue au thought leadership de WPP Enterprise Solutions sur les enjeux d’écosystème et de plateformes (IA, data, commerce, CX), via des prises de parole conjointes valorisant nos réussites dans une logique de ROI business,

- Construit et fait vivre un patrimoine de connaissances sur l’écosystème technologique (roadmaps produits, niveaux et programmes de partenariat, dispositifs de financement) afin d’accélérer et de fluidifier l’action commerciale,

- Incarne, diffuse et fait vivre l’excellence du modèle partenaires en interne, en particulier auprès des communautés commerciale et managériale, pour l’inspirer et développer son réflexe écosystème.

Dimension Enablement & Delivery : 

- Travaille de concert avec le CTO, à qui revient la responsabilité de l’enablement, des certifications et de la montée en compétences des équipes sur les plateformes partenaires ; il s’assure que ces chantiers progressent au rythme des priorités business et des engagements pris auprès des partenaires,

- Veille à la disponibilité et à la capitalisation des assets conjoints (cas clients, références, supports de co-vente) et au partage des retours d’expérience.

Profil recherché 

Vous justifiez de 5 à 10 ans d’expérience, dont une expérience significative en alliances / partenariats technologiques, channel ou business development – idéalement acquise en cabinet de conseil, ESN, agence ou chez un éditeur / hyperscaler.

Notre croissance reposant sur un écosystème de partenaires technologiques (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), vous maîtrisez les mécaniques de co-selling, de co-marketing et de joint business planning.

Vous pouvez justifier de contributions ou de succès significatifs dans le cadre d’initiatives partenaires ou de développement business, au-delà d’en comprendre la logique ou les bonnes pratiques.

Votre capacité à nouer des relations de grande qualité, tant avec les équipes partenaires (alliance managers, channel, avant-vente) qu’avec les décideurs internes (Directions commerciales, Business Units, Marketing), fait de vous un orchestrateur d’écosystème performant, du sourcing d’opportunités à la conclusion de deals conjoints équilibrant les intérêts du partenaire, du client et de WPP Enterprise Solutions.

Les enjeux des plateformes technologiques et de l’écosystème IA / data / commerce vous passionnent, et vous savez vous appuyer sur vos expériences pour bâtir un discours solide en interne comme auprès des partenaires.

Votre rigueur et votre curiosité font de vous un acteur à la fois à l’aise dans la logique de développement business sur des clients existants que sur de la conquête opportuniste, ou en relai d’un partenaire.

La maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, est indispensable : vous adressez des partenaires et des interlocuteurs internationaux de manière totalement autonome.

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Ce que nous proposons

- Prise en charge à 75% des transports en commun

- Une carte restaurant à 11€/jour

- Cours d'anglais, massages, yoga

- Soirées et team building réguliers

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Intégrer WPP Enterprise Solutions, c’est choisir d’évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, humain et innovant, propice au développement de chacun, à la réalisation de missions enrichissantes et aux évolutions de carrière. Nous rejoindre, c’est participer à une aventure collective au service de l’épanouissement personnel.

title: Principal Security Engineer
description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role 

You'll be Vibe's founding security hire. Security has been part of how we build since day one and we're already SOC 2 Type 2 compliant, but nobody has owned it full-time. Ad spend and headcount have both roughly doubled every year since 2022, enterprise partnerships keep expanding, and the more visible Vibe becomes, the more scrutiny comes with it. Now it needs an owner.

You'll define the risk model, set the roadmap, decide what we harden and what we accept, and turn policies into running procedures in code on the paths engineers and AI already use. That work happens in a cloud native ecosystem across AWS and GCP, with most of our services running on Kubernetes, everything as code and a GitOps deployment model.

Reporting to our, Head of Infrastructure, and joining a lean six-person Infrastructure and IT team. You won't do it alone, but you'll be the main contributor, and the person every team turns to on security. Since we joined forces with Walmart, you'll also coordinate directly with their cloud security teams.

What You'll Do 

Risk & Governance 

- Map Vibe's risk model across every major system.

title: Customer Success Account Manager, Mid-Market
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

- You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

- You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work : One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

- You thrive the most when solving problems : Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.

- You are a natural relationship builder : Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.

- You are the architect of your own career : If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.

- You want to be with the best : At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

- Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.

- Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.

- Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.

- Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.

- Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.

- Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

- Business fluency in French (spoken and written).

- 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.

- A record of consistent quota over-achievement.

- Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.

- Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.

- Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.

- A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.

- An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.

- Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.

- Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity 

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers 

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

title: Stage M2 : Recherche en optique non linéaire appliquée à la caractérisation de dispositifs électroniques neuromorphiques - 6 mois
description:
Mines Saint-Etienne est une Ecole de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe public d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France. L’IMT est un EPSCP (grand établissement) sous la tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté Industrielle et Numérique.

L’École Nationale Supérieure des Mines de Saint-Étienne (Mines Saint-Etienne) est chargée de missions de formation, de recherche et d’innovation, de transfert vers l’industrie et de culture scientifique, technique et industrielle.

Mines Saint-Etienne représente: 2 400 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation, 480 personnels (150 Chercheurs et Enseignants-chercheurs), un budget consolidé de 46 M€, 3 campus dédiés à l’industrie à Saint-Etienne et Lyon (région AURA), à la microélectronique et aux objets connectés à Gardanne (Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence, région SUD) et à l’ingénierie pour la santé à Saint-Etienne ; 6 unités de recherche ; 5 centres de formation et de recherche ; un centre de culture scientifique technique et industrielle leader en France « La Rotonde » (> 50 000 visiteurs / an).

Contexte scientifique et objectifs du stage : 

Des dispositifs d’électronique organique ultra-flexibles, conformables et implantables incorporant une intelligence artificielle promettent de révolutionner la surveillance et le traitement en temps réel de maladies chroniques [1]. De tels systèmes pourraient être basés sur des transistors organiques électrochimiques (OECTs), exploitant des conducteurs polymères mixtes ion-électron (PMIECs) comme couches actives. En effet, les PMIECs sont apparus comme une excellente plateforme matérielle pour interfacer la biologie avec l’électronique conventionnelle ; identifié comme le domaine de la « bioélectronique organique ou plastique ». L’OECT est considéré comme l’éléments clé pour réaliser une telle interface [2]. Son efficacité est évaluée suivant des figures de mérite (FoMs) telles que i) la transconductance (gm), et/ou ii) les temps de commutation (ionique vs. électronique) dans le dispositif. Au-delà des applications de transduction, à court terme, l’OECT est aussi intéressant pour créer des applications émergentes en matière de circuits neuromorphiques bioélectroniques [3].

La réalisation de tels circuits est freinée par un manque de compréhension et d’optimisation des processus de conduction mixte dans ces matériaux polymériques ; notamment une asymétrie des temps de commutation des transistors lors des séquences de dopage (i.e « ON ») vs dédopage (i.e « OFF ») dans le canal de l’OECT. Des outils de caractérisation in-situ & operando permettant de quantifier et cartographier les paramètres de transduction électronique et électrochimique dans le canal de l’OECT se révèlent être indispensables pour comprendre les limitations actuelles en performances des PMIECs et/ou pour construire des PMIECs optimums dans de tels circuits neuromorphiques.

Dans ce contexte scientifique, le.la stagiaire développera une nouvelle mesure de spectroscopie et instrumentation d’optique non linéaire, appelée microscopie par génération de second harmonique résolue en temps, afin d’enregistrer le mouvement spatio-temporel des espèces chargées, ion et électrons (ou trous), et ainsi donc cartographier les mobilités électroniques in-situ & operando le canal de l’OECT.

La.le stagiaire fabriquera ces dispositifs OECTs en salle blanche de microélectronique, et bénéficiera d’un accompagnement technique pour leur réalisation. Il.elle enregistrera et analysera les FoMs clés grâce à l'expérimentation d’optique non linéaire développée et aux caractérisations électriques et électrochimiques afin d’établir, de manière plus globale, des règles d’ingénierie dans ces PMIECs qui serviront de socle de connaissances incontournables à l’avenir, pour mettre en œuvre et appliquer des circuits neuromorphiques à base d'OECTs, comme première brique d’une intelligence artificielle d’électronique organique.

Pour aller plus loin :

[2] https://doi.org/10.1038/ s43586-021-00065-8 

[3] https://www.nature.com/articles/s41578-023-00622-5 

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous 

La candidate ou le candidat devra être en cours de formation et d’apprentissage d’un diplôme de Master 2 ou de 3ème année de diplôme d’ingénieurs en Techniques Optiques et Instrumentations. La candidate ou le candidat devra disposer d’une culture solide en Physique/ Science des Matériaux/ (Opto)Électronique par sa formation initiale et/ou son expérience professionnelle.

Ce sujet de stage M2 Recherche a vocation d’être poursuivi en cycle de doctorat. Seul.e un.e étudiant.e intéressé.e pour continuer en doctorat sera donc retenu.e pour ce stage.

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons 

Les principaux critères d’évaluation du candidat seront les suivants (liste non exhaustive) :

- Maitrise technique et scientifique en Optique. Des expériences lors de précédents stages en optique non linéaire et/ou microscopie, analyse d’images par caméra scientifique sera considéré comme avantageuses,

description:

Together, we imagine and build a sustainable future by educating the leaders who will shape tomorrow’s transitions.

🎯 What we expect from you 

As a Postdoctoral Researcher or Research Engineer, you will perform research and innovation activities in the field of soft electronics and optical sensing for artificial skin applications. Within the Centre of Microelectronics and the Flexible Electronics Department (FEL), you will contribute to the development of stretchable optical waveguides and their integration into artificial skin demonstrators.

The flexible electronics department develops technological and scientific knowledge in the field of soft electronics. The department has a strong knowledge in the field of material and interface electrical and mechanical characterization. The activities of the department are regrouped in the 660m2-area platform. This technological platform regroups facilities and technological equipment for R&D activities in Micropackaging, micro and nano-electronics, in a clean room of 220m² 1000-class and 400m² 10000-class.

Stretchable electronics can also be combined with optical systems such as waveguides. These devices will be developed to create artificial skin with pressure and temperature sensing capabilities.

Within this project, the work will focus on the fabrication and characterization of stretchable optical waveguides, as well as on fabrication and integration techniques for optical components (LEDs / photodiodes). A related publication is “Transparent, Optical, Pressure-Sensitive Artificial Skin for Large-Area Stretchable Electronics” (https://doi.org/10.1002/adma.201200523).

The main activities will include:

· Fabrication and characterization of elastomer waveguides for pressure and temperature sensing applications.

· Integration of optically pressure- or temperature-sensitive materials into the elastomer waveguides.

· Characterization and validation of complete sensing devices.

The fabrication processes and experimental setups are already available. However, good knowledge of Python is important for operating and further developing the test benches. Hands-on laboratory work is essential and will be partly performed in our clean room facility.

The expected outcome is the demonstration of radically new soft optical sensing devices with features and functions that cannot be achieved with conventional electronic approaches. This work is part of a European project involving multiple partners across Europe, including ETH Zurich (ETHZ), the University of Oxford, Johannes Kepler University Linz, EMPA…

title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
description:
The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability. 

Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain. 

This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing. 

The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains. 

A major aspect of the PhD will be the development of system-level evaluation and benchmarking methodologies within a design-technology co-optimization (DTCO/SDTCO) framework. The objective is to provide quantitative and objective metrics for decision-making, including scalability analysis, computational throughput, and energy efficiency for target AI workloads. These evaluations will support both intermediate design exploration and the potential experimental validation of fabricated demonstrators within the broader program. 

In addition, the PhD will address electronic circuit design challenges associated with photonic accelerators, including interface circuits for control, programming of PCM elements, optical-to-electrical readout, and signal conversion. These aspects are critical for ensuring the practical integration of photonic computing units within heterogeneous AI hardware systems. 

The expected outcome is a set of novel architectures, models, and evaluation tools that will clarify the potential and limitations of silicon photonics for next-generation AI accelerators, and provide guidelines for scalable and energy-efficient implementations.

Background: The candidate should hold or be about to obtain an MSc in Electronics Engineering, Photonics, or Computer Engineering. A strong background in computer architecture, integrated circuits, or photonic systems is expected. Knowledge of AI hardware accelerators, in-memory computing, or silicon photonics will be appreciated. 

Environment: The PhD will be carried out at the INL laboratory, within the CAMELIA program, as part of the LEAF project, in collaboration between leading academic and institutional partners in AI hardware and photonics. 

Starting dates: Fall 2026

C'est le rôle de l'AI Lab.

C'est l'équipe pivot qui construit les outils internes qui changent la façon dont Agicap travaille au quotidien. Notre boussole : impact opérationnel rapide , itérations courtes, travail à 360° avec toutes les équipes (Sales, CS, Finance, Produit, Marketing, Data, C-level).

C'est une création de poste : l'accélération de l'IA change nos process et notre manière de bosser. On a besoin d'un renfort senior pour accompagner cette transition et l'inscrire dans des pratiques qui tiennent sur le long terme.

L'équipe que tu vas rejoindre : 

- 4 personnes , toi inclus : un ingénieur IA junior , un Tech Lead à mi-temps (qui sera ton manager), un Product Manager .

- Ton rôle : apporter le recul technique qui manque aujourd'hui dans l'équipe (infra, architecture, maintenabilité, scalabilité) — construire vite, mais sans creuser de dette pour demain.

- Tu es en interaction directe avec toutes les équipes métier d'Agicap : c'est un poste très transverse, très exposé.

Tu alternes entre cadrage rapide, build et itération :

- Comprendre le besoin d'une équipe métier en direct, cadrer ce qui a réellement de l'impact vs. ce qui est du confort, prioriser.

- Construire les outils internes de bout en bout : cadrage → dev → mise en prod → itération avec les utilisateurs.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe commerciale pour que les clients adoptent l’IA grâce à nos partenaires.

Ce poste est un poste de construction, et non de gestion. Compte tenu du stade de développement d’Anthropic, nous recherchons un profil qui a déjà fait ses preuves en faisant passer des partenariats de zéro à des moteurs de revenus à grande échelle, un profil qui a bâti ces relations de A à Z, et non simplement hérité de relations existantes pour les gérer.

Responsabilités 

- Partenariats et exécution

- Vous accompagnerez les partenaires dans la création de solutions clients reproductibles, répondant à des cas d’usage précis dans de nombreux secteurs : services financiers, santé, distribution, industrie, secteur public et services professionnels.

- Performance et pilotage des indicateurs clés (KPI)

- Vous portez la responsabilité des indicateurs clés de performance et vous les pilotez : revenus influencés par les partenaires, livraison réalisée par les partenaires, nombre de personnes consultantes formées et certifiées.

- Chaque deal influencé par votre portefeuille de partenaires doit être conçu pour la réussite du client et la croissance de sa valeur à long terme. Vous définirez des critères de réussite pour les comptes communs, veillerez à la qualité de la mise en œuvre et de l’accompagnement à l’adoption, et mettrez en place des boucles de retour d’expérience favorisant l’amélioration continue.

- Vous rendrez compte de la santé des partenariats, de leur avancement et de leurs résultats commerciaux, en vous appuyant sur des analyses fondées sur les données.

- Développement du marché et construction de la marque

- Vous renforcerez la notoriété de la marque Anthropic en France grâce à des relations stratégiques avec les partenaires.

- Vous élaborerez et déploierez des stratégies de mise sur le marché (GTM) propres à chaque marché, adaptées aux pratiques commerciales et aux nuances culturelles locales.

- Vous composerez avec les enjeux locaux de réglementation, de conformité et de souveraineté des données.

- Vous créerez un avantage concurrentiel grâce aux capacités singulières des partenaires et à des propositions de valeur élaborées en commun.

Votre profil 

Ce poste pourrait vous convenir si vous réunissez les atouts suivants :

- Vous avez l’esprit d’initiative et le goût de construire : vous êtes à l’aise pour partir de zéro et créer des partenariats d’envergure.

- Vous maîtrisez l’anglais et le français.

- Vous comptez au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans les partenariats technologiques à destination des entreprises, idéalement dans le cloud, l’IA/ML ou les activités de plateforme.

- Vous avez une culture de la donnée, tournée vers les résultats mesurables et l’atteinte des KPI, et un historique avéré de revenus additionnels générés grâce aux partenariats dans la région.

- Vous avez démontré votre capacité à assurer la réussite des clients et la protection de la marque via les canaux partenaires.

- Vous avez l’esprit de compétition : la victoire et la différenciation sont votre moteur.

- Vous avez une approche collaborative et savez travailler de façon transversale avec les équipes commerciales, produit, marketing et régionales.

- Vous nourrissez une vraie passion pour l’IA et vous vous reconnaissez dans la mission d’Anthropic : développer une IA bénéfique.

Relations de travail 

Votre rattachement hiérarchique se fera auprès de la direction des partenariats internationaux, tandis que votre activité quotidienne sera pilotée par la personne responsable des partenariats EMEA Sud. Vous travaillerez également en étroite collaboration avec la direction commerciale régionale d’Anthropic et ses Account Executives, ainsi qu’avec les équipes Customer Success et Applied AI de la région.

Lieu et déplacements 

Ce poste est basé à Paris, en France, avec des déplacements à prévoir pour rencontrer les partenaires et les clients.

About the Role

This is a critical leadership role responsible for building and scaling Anthropic's consulting, GSIs and AI-native boutique partners in France.
You will be working closely with the sales team to make sure customers are adopting AI through our partners.

This is a builder role, not a manager role. Given Anthropic's stage, we need someone who has proven they can take partnerships from zero to scaled revenue engines — someone who has built these relationships from the ground up, not just inherited and managed existing ones.

Responsibilities: 

- Partnerships and execution: 

- You will engage closely with the sales team to understand how partners can support customer Claude adoption

- You will guide partners in creating repeatable customer solutions that address specific use cases across industries including financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, public sector, and professional services.

- Performance and KPI ownership:

- Own and drive key performance indicators, partner-influenced revenue, partner delivery, consultants trained and certified

- Every deal influenced through your partner portfolio must be architected for customer success and long-term value expansion. You will establish success criteria for joint accounts, ensure proper implementation and adoption support, and create feedback loops that drive continuous improvement.

- Report on partnership health, progress, and commercial outcomes with data-driven insights

- Market Development & Brand Building

- Amplify the Anthropic brand in France strategic partner relationships

- Develop and execute market-specific GTM strategies adapted to local business practices and cultural nuances

- Navigate local regulatory, compliance, and data sovereignty considerations

- Create competitive differentiation through unique partner capabilities and joint value propositions

You may be a good fit if you have: 

- Builder mentality — comfortable starting from zero and creating scaled partnerships

Fluent in English and French 

- 8+ years of experience in enterprise technology partnerships, ideally within cloud, AI/ML, or platform businesses

- Data-driven mindset with focus on measurable outcomes and KPI attainment. Track record of driving incremental revenues through partnerships in the region

- History of delivering exceptional customer success and brand protection through partner channels

- Competitive drive — obsessed with winning and creating differentiation

- Collaborative approach with ability to work cross-functionally across sales, product, marketing, and regional teams

- Passion for AI and alignment with Anthropic's mission of beneficial AI development

Working Relationships 

You will formally report to the International Partnerships leader, while your day-to-day work will be led by our South EMEA Partnerships lead. You will also partner closely with Anthropic's regional sales leader and their Account Executives, as well as the in-region Customer Success and Applied AI teams.

Location and Travel 

This role will be based in Paris, France with travel expected to engage with partners and customers externally.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

€220.000 — €260.000 EUR 

Logistics

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different 

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

title: Product Manager (Protocol)
description:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here .

Location

Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

Role

Morpho's Protocol team is evolving the core lending infrastructure that powers products and markets across the ecosystem. As the number of opportunities, integrations, and protocol initiatives grows, the team needs clear product direction on what to build, why it matters, and how to sequence the work. 

This role will work with Morpho’s protocol team to shape product strategy and guide execution. You will turn the needs of users and ecosystem partners into a focused roadmap, work closely with protocol and engineering teams to shape solutions, and drive improvements from discovery through launch and adoption. You will operate at the intersection of deeply technical systems, financial markets, and a fast-moving ecosystem.

Responsibilities

- Own the roadmap for Morpho's protocol team, defining the highest-impact problems to solve and sequencing opportunities against company goals, user needs, technical constraints, and ecosystem dynamics.

- Build and run a continuous discovery process with curators, distributors, integrators, developers, and other protocol users to understand their workflows, pain points, and emerging needs.

- Translate user and market insights into clear product requirements, decision frameworks, and success criteria that help protocol and engineering teams move quickly with strong rationale.

- Partner closely with protocol, engineering, research, security, legal, solutions, partnerships, and marketing to take initiatives from early exploration through design, implementation, audit, launch, and adoption.

- Evaluate product and technical tradeoffs, including when to extend the protocol, improve surrounding infrastructure, enable partners, or deliberately avoid adding complexity.

- Define and track the signals that show whether protocol initiatives are working, combining quantitative data with ecosystem feedback to guide iteration and future investment.

- Communicate product direction, decisions, tradeoffs, and release implications clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders.

- Improve how product decisions are made and documented as Morpho and its protocol ecosystem scale.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

You understand Morpho's protocol, development and release process, current roadmap, and the rationale behind the major initiatives in flight. You have built relationships across protocol, engineering, research, security, and go-to-market teams, and have started speaking with key curators, distributors, integrators, and developers.

First 3 months

You have established a clear, prioritized view of the most important protocol problems and opportunities. The roadmap reflects explicit tradeoffs, user evidence, technical constraints, and measurable outcomes. You have driven at least one meaningful initiative from discovery into execution and proactively keep stakeholders aligned on decisions and changes.

First 6 months

You have shipped a meaningful protocol improvement and can show how it advanced user or business outcomes. Product, protocol, and engineering teams have stronger shared context on what to build and why. You consistently identify important user needs, ecosystem shifts, and roadmap conflicts early, and have improved Morpho's product discovery and decision-making process.

Must Have Experience & Skills

- 5+ years building technical products in complex or fast-changing environments.

- Proven track record taking products or major features from ambiguous problem spaces through launch and iteration.

- Strong technical fluency, with the ability to reason about system design and constraints, engage deeply with engineers and researchers, and translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

- Excellent product judgment: you can distinguish important user problems from requests, make principled tradeoffs, and focus teams on the work with the greatest impact.

- Strong user discovery and synthesis skills, with the ability to uncover needs across different user types and turn incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear direction.

- Experience leading cross-functional work without relying on formal authority.

- Ability to define success, use quantitative and qualitative evidence, and adapt direction as new information emerges.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, especially in an async environment.

- Comfort creating clarity and driving decisions in highly ambiguous contexts.

- Strong ownership and autonomy: you act without waiting to be told.

- Team-first mindset, low ego.

Nice to Have

- Experience in crypto, DeFi, traditional finance, or fintech.

- Familiarity with lending markets, smart contracts, or permissionless protocols.

- Experience shipping products with significant security, audit, regulatory, or governance considerations.

- Experience working with research & development teams

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

Compensation: $185K – $250K

Spécialisée dans l'IA appliquée dans les entreprises (grands groupes, comptes publics, ETI, PME), ILLUIN est pionnière du NLP francophone et mène ses propres recherches en IA générative. Nos consultants interviennent en immersion chez le client pour déployer des solutions IA à fort impact (assistants conversationnels, automatisation documentaire, analyse de données), avec la vision agnostique des technologies IA (solutions du marché, produits Illuin, des approches sur mesure).

Vous pilotez la transformation IA d'un périmètre métier. Vous construisez la stratégie d'adoption, orchestrez les acteurs (direction, métiers, IT, Data) et garantissez un impact mesurable, du cadrage des cas d'usage jusqu'à l'ancrage des nouveaux usages.

- Qualifier et prioriser le portefeuille de cas d'usage selon la valeur, la faisabilité et les risques

- Concevoir les processus cibles intégrant l'IA et les agents, et définir les interactions entre l'humain et l'IA

- Construire les business cases et les critères Go / No Go avec les décideurs

- Identifier dès le cadrage les prérequis de sécurité, de gouvernance et de qualité des données

- Éclairer les arbitrages entre produits existants et développements sur mesure (Make vs Buy)

- Séquencer les déploiements pour que chaque cas d'usage renforce le suivant

- Piloter le passage des pilotes à l'échelle avec les équipes de delivery ILLUIN

- Préparer et animer les instances de pilotage (Coproj, Copil)

- Construire les plans de montée en compétences

- Installer et animer des réseaux d'ambassadeurs IA chez le client

- Identifier les résistances et mettre en place les réponses adaptées

Impact & mesure

Profil recherché : avant tout, vous êtes passionné(e) par l’IA et souhaitez contribuer pour la rendre véritablement utile pour les entreprises

Expérience

Compétences clés

Insurance companies use Akur8 to decide the price of millions of policies. We are looking for a talented Product Engineer to build the features they rely on to do it.

- You take a pragmatic approach to writing code: you care about solving the actual problem rather than chasing perfection, and you can explain the trade-offs behind your technical choices.

- You care about results more than about technology: you want to understand why a feature matters to the end user before deciding how to build it.

Prior experience with our tech stack (Rust, Java, Python, Angular, AWS) or the insurance space is welcome, but not required. We invest heavily in onboarding; what matters most is your curiosity and appetite to learn.

Contrôle interne et contrôle permanent

Risques opérationnels et gestion des risques

- Coordonner la préparation et la mise à jour régulière des cartographies des risques de l’entreprise. 

- Organiser et maintenir le Risk Appetite Framework, ainsi que le suivi des indicateurs d’appétit au risque.

- Suivre les risques opérationnels, non financiers et émergents, notamment les risques liés à la technologie, à la cybersécurité, à la fraude, à l’externalisation et aux processus métiers.

Gouvernance et comités 

- Préparer, coordonner et animer le Comité des risques trimestriel. 

- Accompagner le Chief Compliance & Risk Officer et la Direction générale dans leurs prises de décision liées aux risques. 

- Préparer les supports de gouvernance, tableaux de bord et présentations offrant une vision claire de l’environnement de risques et de contrôle de l’entreprise.

- Contribuer aux processus de reporting réglementaire et interne, notamment au rapport annuel sur le contrôle interne, ainsi qu’aux autres reportings réglementaires applicables.

Audits et contrôles réglementaires

- Être le point de contact principal des auditeurs et des autorités compétentes sur les sujets de contrôle interne.

- Coordonner la préparation et la mise en œuvre des plans d’actions correctifs et préventifs.

- Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

description:
Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact. 

Algolia is set to enable every company to create world-class Search and Discovery experiences with an API-first approach. Performance and Scalability is at the heart of our mission: we power 1.5 trillion searches a year, for 10K+ customers all over the world. 

If you're a problem solver, able to think outside the box and eager to nurture others and learn from them, then this is your challenge!

The Team

The Platform as a Service (PaaS) team is dedicated to empowering development teams by creating toolchains, guidelines, and standards. Our focus is on enabling seamless automation and CI/CD, comprehensive observability, and unwavering reliability in a secured cloud-native environment.

The Opportunity

The Senior Site Reliability Engineer (IC4) position within the Platform As a Service team presents an exciting opportunity for a seasoned professional to enhance scalable infrastructure with a focus on CI/CD, Observability, and application hosting. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our junior and senior staff, playing a critical role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of Algolia’s Search Products.

As a senior contributor, you will be responsible for building and optimizing systems that ensure the platform’s efficiency and reliability, while also mentoring junior engineers and collaborating across teams. Your work will be pivotal in improving infrastructure, enhancing observability standards, and streamlining CI/CD processes. You will play a significant role in transitioning legacy systems to a modern Kubernetes-based architecture, contributing to long-term infrastructure strategies, and ensuring alignment with business needs.

Your role will consist of:

- 
CI/CD Development and Maintenance : Contribute to the design, optimization, and maintenance of the CI/CD pipelines to improve the speed, reliability, and efficiency of the development lifecycle. Assist in driving standardization across various services hosted on the platform.

- 
Observability Enhancement : Lead efforts to improve the observability of critical systems, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure actionable monitoring and alerting frameworks are in place. Help troubleshoot complex issues and optimize system reliability.

- 
Kubernetes and Cloud Management : Contribute to the development and operation of our Kubernetes-based architecture. Ensure systems are resilient, scalable, and optimized for performance. Actively participate in enhancing cloud-based solutions for API management and microservices.

- 
System Optimization and Scaling : Collaborate with team members to ensure system scalability, operability, and performance. Lead initiatives to optimize resource utilization, focusing on cost efficiency while maintaining high system availability.

- 
Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing : Mentor mid-level engineers (IC3) by providing guidance on technical challenges and SRE best practices. Support team growth by fostering knowledge-sharing sessions and helping establish processes that drive operational excellence.

- 
Cross-Team Collaboration : Work closely with product, software, and other SRE teams to ensure that platform goals align with broader business objectives. Drive initiatives aimed at enhancing platform stability, security, and scalability.

You might be a fit if you have:

- 
Strong Programming Skills : Proficient in Golang and Python with a solid understanding of software craftsmanship. Knowledge of Ruby is a plus.

- 
Experience in CI/CD Pipelines : Hands-on experience in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or alternatives. Familiarity with best practices for ensuring build and deployment reliability.

- 
Observability : Experience designing and implementing monitoring, alerting, and observability frameworks that provide actionable insights. Strong troubleshooting skills in production environments.

- 
Kubernetes and Cloud Infrastructure : Proven experience in managing and optimizing Kubernetes-based architectures and working with public cloud providers such as GCP, AWS, or Microsoft Azure.

- 
Distributed Systems Expertise : Experience in designing, building, and operating distributed systems at scale, with a focus on reliability, availability, and performance.

- 
Mentorship and Leadership : Experience mentoring junior engineers and helping them grow. Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute to strategic initiatives.

- 
Problem-Solving Skills : Ability to independently solve complex technical problems with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively with other team members.

- 
Excellent Communication and Organizational Skills : Strong ability to communicate complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to organize and prioritize multiple projects.

Base Salary Pay Range

€69.768 — €96.900 EUR 

FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY: 

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when. 

We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule. 

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES: 

- GRIT - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.

- TRUST - Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.

- CANDOR - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.

- CARE - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.

- HUMILITY - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.

We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. title: Technical Project Manager - Engineering Delivery
description:
Diabolocom is looking for a Technical Project Manager to coordinate engineering delivery across our organization and work closely with the Head of Software Engineering on roadmap execution. 

You will work across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to keep delivery on track, manage dependencies, identify risks early, and help turn delivery challenges into clear actions and decisions. 

We are looking for someone with a software engineering background who has moved into technical leadership and genuinely enjoys the operational side of engineering. 

The role 

Our engineering organization includes around 90 engineers across 12 teams , working on a complex global product and multiple parallel initiatives. 

This role combines ownership of our engineering delivery processes with hands-on execution . You will be responsible not only for running these processes, but also for continuously improving how we plan, coordinate and track delivery across the organization. 

Process ownership 

You will own and continuously improve: 

- engineering delivery planning processes 

- delivery tracking and reporting 

- cross-team coordination and dependency management. 

You will build on our existing practices and ClickUp workflows, identifying what can work better and evolving the processes as the organization and product develop. 

Delivery execution 

Day to day, you will: 

- track delivery across teams and releases 

- coordinate dependencies and clarify ownership across teams 

- identify risks, blockers and delivery gaps early 

- challenge unclear timelines, priorities and commitments 

- coordinate next steps when delivery is at risk 

- provide clear visibility on delivery status and progress. 

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to facilitate alignment. 

The objective is simple: make software delivery predictable, transparent and effective . 

What success looks like 

First few weeks: You start taking ownership of delivery operations and become effective in coordinating ongoing delivery. 

Within ~6-8 weeks: You understand the roadmap, teams, dependencies and delivery processes well enough to manage them confidently and start identifying opportunities for improvement. 

Within 3 months: You operate autonomously across day-to-day engineering delivery coordination, bringing in the Head of Software Engineering when decisions or trade-offs require escalation. 

Your work will directly influence our delivery efficiency and predictability : how much we can take on and how reliably we deliver what we commit to. 

Who we are looking for 

We are looking for someone who started in software engineering and moved into technical leadership , for example, an Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, senior Team Lead, or Technical Program Manager. 

Titles matter less than scope. You need enough technical depth to understand architecture and dependencies, ask the right questions, and navigate complex delivery problems across teams. 

We expect 

- around 10 years of experience in software engineering environments 

- at least 3 years in engineering or technical leadership 

- previous hands-on experience as a software engineer 

- experience leading or coordinating multiple engineering teams 

- a track record of delivering complex software initiatives and improving execution 

- strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, distributed systems and cross-team dependencies 

- understanding of Product Management fundamentals 

- experience with Agile and structured project management frameworks such as PMBOK or similar 

- strong prioritization, decision-making and communication skills 

- professional fluency in English . 

French and Russian are nice to have. 

This role will suit you if… 

You still enjoy technical complexity , but what really motivates you is making execution work. 

You like finding out why something is stuck and fixing it. 

You genuinely enjoy the operational side of engineering: creating structure, improving processes, coordinating teams and making sure things get delivered. 

You don’t just want to follow an established process. You naturally look for ways to make it work better. 

You are comfortable working across multiple teams, asking difficult questions when needed, and bringing structure to situations where priorities, dependencies or timelines are not immediately clear. 

Why Diabolocom 

Diabolocom is building one of Europe’s most advanced AI-native CCaaS platforms , powering business-critical customer interactions for 400+ enterprise and mid-market customers across 60+ countries . 

We combine a mature global CCaaS platform with a rapidly growing AI Product Suite , backed by our internal AI Research Lab and proprietary AI innovation. 

Our ambition goes beyond adding AI features to an existing product. We are building toward a platform capable of orchestrating AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels , with CCaaS as the execution layer. 

For Engineering, this means working on the technical and operational challenges of an established enterprise product, from real-time communications and distributed systems to complex integrations, while contributing to its next generation. 

With teams across Europe, the US, Brazil and the UAE, and an engineering organization of around 90 people , this role offers the opportunity to work on engineering delivery behind a global product used for critical customer operations. 

Why this role 

This is a hands-on role combining delivery execution with process ownership . 

You will work with the Head of Software Engineering, Team Leads, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams, with a broad view of engineering delivery across the organization. 

You will inherit established delivery practices, own them, and continuously improve how we plan, coordinate and track execution. 

Recruitment process 

- Introductory call with Talent Acquisition 

- Interview with the Head of Software Engineering 

- Interview with the CTO 

- Interview with the Head of Product

📍 Paris, France

💻 Equipment: choose your preferred setup (Mac/Linux + monitors) 
🍽 Lunch vouchers 
🚇 Navigo: 50% of the monthly pass reimbursed

Qualifikation

title: System Architect
description:
Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness.

As a System Architect, you will be responsible for our solid-state transformer as a complete system. You will connect the work of our power electronics, magnetics, and mechanical and thermal engineering teams into one coherent system, and ensure it meets the requirements of hyperscale data center customers.

Instead of specializing in a single subsystem, your mission is to keep the whole system in view: balancing efficiency, size, cost, reliability and manufacturability, guiding the key technical trade-offs, and taking our SST from prototype to a product ready for certification and series production.

This role is for you if… 
you’ve owned a complex high-power system rather than one part of it. You enjoy keeping the whole picture in view, making the call on trade-offs between expert teams, and bringing just enough structure to a fast-moving team without slowing it down.

This role isn’t for you if… 
you’ve spent your career going deep on a single component or subsystem, or you manage projects without making the technical decisions yourself. It’s also not a fit if you need a fixed specification and established processes before you can start.

Key Responsibilities 

- Own the system architecture of the SST and its key performance metrics, including efficiency, power density, cost, thermal performance, reliability, manufacturability and control performance.

- Coordinate the subsystems of the SST (AC/DC, DC/DC, magnetics, mechanical and thermal) and their interfaces, ensuring the work of each team is compatible and consistent with the system design.

- Lead system-level trade-off decisions and set technical priorities across teams.

- Define and maintain system requirements, interface specifications and change management, ensuring design changes are assessed for their impact across the system.

- Translate the requirements of data center operators and hyperscalers into system specifications, and track how they evolve.

- Explore and compare different system architectures and their integration in the datacenter power supply chain

- Drive standardization and design for manufacturing across subsystems in preparation for series production.

- Work with the compliance and certification team to define a feasible certification path for the system.

- Identify technical risks at system level early and propose mitigations.

Qualifications 

- MSc or a higher degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

- 8+ years of industry experience in developing complex power electronic systems.

- Proven responsibility at system or platform level, e.g. as system engineer, system architect, technical lead or team lead.

- Track record of taking power electronic systems from development to series product.

- Experience with high-power systems such as EV charging, electric drivetrains, rail traction, industrial drives, renewable energy converters or robotics.

- Broad understanding of the electrical, magnetic, thermal, mechanical and control aspects of power electronic systems, and how they interact.

- Working knowledge of cooling concepts and the mechanical integration of high-power electronics.

- Experience with standards, norms and certification processes for power electronic products.

- Strong communication and decision-making skills; able to align experts across disciplines and drive decisions.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving requirements.

The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.

Nice to Have 

- Experience with medium-voltage converter systems or solid-state transformers.

- Knowledge of data center power architectures.

- Experience in design for manufacturing and cost engineering.

- Experience establishing systems engineering processes in a growing organization.

Benefits

- Unique technology and market opportunity – shape the architecture of a new product category for the energy transition.
