title: (Senior) Deployment Strategist
description:
You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants. 

Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Palantir, McKinsey, Meta, Google, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT? 

You will take a signed logo and turn them into a flagship reference. That means getting onto the shopfloor fast, understanding what drives their KPIs, and deploying Ethon's agentic workflows where the impact is highest. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. This is what you'll do:

- Own the deployment: You're the person who makes sure go-live happens on time and the customer's team knows how to use it. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations.

- Turn shopfloor problems into business cases: An operator tells you yield drops on line 3 every Tuesday night. You figure out why, quantify what it costs, and build the case for the next deployment. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations.

- Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed.

- Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor.

- Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better.

- Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING? 

The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck.

- You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case

- You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor

- You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors

- You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools

- You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it

- You're open to travel 30-50% of the time

This is how we'll set you up in your first six months:

- Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account.

- Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team.

- Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion.

Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like:

- Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes

- Top-tier consulting, ready to stop writing recommendations and start executing them

- Digital transformation or operational excellence roles inside manufacturing companies, where things were moving too slowly for you

- Manufacturing or process engineering, where you've lived the problems Ethon solves, you know what a plant manager actually cares about, and customers trust you the moment you walk onto their floor

- A technical degree in chemical, mechanical, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field

Bonus:

- Experience with MES, ERP, Historian, or quality systems in manufacturing environments

- Fluency in German, French, or another European language

WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU? 

We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here outgrow their title fast.

- Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation

- Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching

description:

8+ years of software development or equivalent experience in the software development domain, with a strong understanding of software testing.

Having a developer mindset: experience with coding lifecycle, ability to produce secure code, to do code reviews, and to jump into an unknown codebase, language, and framework.

A growth mindset and a passion for helping individuals and teams reach their full potential.

Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and resources effectively.

Ability to clearly identify the problem to be solved and articulate it, before jumping to possible solutions/actions.

-

-

title: CFO (Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung)
description:
Das Universitäre Zentrum für Zahnmedizin Basel (UZB) vereint Patientenbehandlung, akademische Lehre und Forschung unter einem Dach. Mit rund 300 Mitarbeitenden, rund 100'000 Behandlungen pro Jahr und einem Umsatz von ca. CHF 40 Mio. erbringt das UZB seine Leistungen unter anderem auf Basis von Leistungsaufträgen mit der Universität Basel und dem Kanton Basel-Stadt. Wir suchen eine oder einen CFO mit überzeugenden betriebswirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Kenntnissen. Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung ist neben dem Finanzwissen auch unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln gefragt, um das Unternehmen gesamtheitlich zu steuern und weiterzuentwickeln.

Ihre Verantwortung

- Sie verantworten die finanzielle Führung des UZB – von der Budget-, Liquiditäts- und Finanzplanung über das Rechnungswesen und die Rechnungslegung nach Swiss GAAP FER bis hin zum Controlling – und stellen ein aussagekräftiges, stufengerechtes Reporting an unsere Leitungserbringer, die Geschäftsleitung und den Verwaltungsrat sicher.

- Sie sichern die Finanzierung und Liquidität, entwickeln das Risikomanagement und das interne Kontrollsystem weiter und sind Ansprechperson für den Prüfungsausschuss des Verwaltungsrats und die Revisionsstelle.

- Sie führen und entwickeln die Bereiche Finanzen (rund 10 Mitarbeitende), IT (3), Technischer Dienst (3) und Einkauf mit vier direkt unterstellten Führungspersonen und fördern die Zusammenarbeit über Fachgrenzen hinweg.

- Sie bringen die Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Abläufen und Systemen voran und entscheiden bei der laufenden Evaluation einer neuen ERP-Lösung massgeblich mit.

- Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung tragen Sie auch die gesamtunternehmerische Verantwortung mit und bringen sich in Fragen der Unternehmensentwicklung aktiv ein.

- Sie beraten die CEO und die Geschäftsleitung als Sparringpartner in allen betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragen und erarbeiten Business Cases für neue Angebote und Projekte.

- Sie schaffen Entscheidungsgrundlagen für den Dialog mit internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen in einem öffentlich-rechtlich geprägten Umfeld und pflegen den Kontakt zu den relevanten Stakeholdern.

Ihr beruflicher Hintergrund

- Sie verfügen über substanzielles Know-how in Finanzen und Controlling sowie über Erfahrung in einer verantwortlichen Finanzführungsfunktion.

- Sie haben einen (Fach-) Hochschulstudium in Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen oder sind Expertin bzw. Experte in Rechnungslegung und Controlling; Erfahrung mit Swiss GAAP FER und SAP ist von Vorteil.

- Sie haben Führungserfahrung, sind es gewohnt bei Entscheidungsprozessen mitzuwirken und anschliessend die Entscheidungen in ihrem Verantwortungsbereich konsequent umzusetzen. Sie kommunizieren differenziert und transparent, arbeiten pragmatisch und verbinden finanzielle Sorgfalt mit Offenheit für neue Lösungen.

- Sie verfügen über stilsichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Sie interessieren sich für Digitalisierung und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Daten und neuen Technologien.

- Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen oder in einer öffentlich-rechtlichen Organisation sind willkommen, doch keine Voraussetzung.

Was die Aufgabe auszeichnet

Das UZB ist eine dynamische Institution: 2016 gegründet und seit 2021 um rund 30 % gewachsen. Unsere Strukturen, Prozesse und Systeme lassen sich aktiv mitprägen. Sie verbinden eine finanzielle Schlüsselrolle mit der Möglichkeit, die Weiterentwicklung einer Unternehmung mit gesellschaftlichem Auftrag aus Geschäftsleitungsperspektive mitzugestalten. Die Position verlangt Nähe zum Tagesgeschäft ebenso wie einen verlässlichen Blick auf das Ganze.

- Strong software engineering skills in Python and SQL. You use AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) daily and can build a working demo application quickly.

- Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) and modern data platforms.

- Proven ability to influence technical leaders up to CTO/CDO level and to explain complex AI topics in business terms.

- Communication: Proven ability to communicate and teach complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Technology Marketing Manager
description:
About the role 

We are looking for a Technology Marketing Manager to turn Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and long-term vision into compelling stories for engineers and executives.

This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, marketing, and go-to-market .

You will develop a deep understanding of Neural Concept’s technology and work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to create and continuously improve how our platform is explained to enterprise audiences.

Your work will directly shape how global enterprises perceive Neural Concept: not as a point solution, but as an intelligence layer that brings AI into engineering workflows , helping Global 2000 engineering leaders design better products faster.

This is a high-impact role with significant autonomy, offering the opportunity to take ownership of complex topics, shape Neural Concept’s technical and market narrative, and potentially grow into leading a product marketing team as the company scales.

What you will do 

Technology & Product Narrative 

- Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and roadmap.

- Act as a primary internal reference for market-facing technology and product narratives.

- Turn complex technical concepts into clear explanations, examples, and value stories for engineering and executive audiences.

- Work closely with leadership and Product to ensure alignment between vision, roadmap, and market messaging.

Messaging & Positioning Framework 

- Structure and maintain the core messaging framework in collaboration with leadership and Sales Enablement.

- Define how Neural Concept’s technology is positioned across personas, industries, and use cases.

- Ensure consistency and clarity across all market-facing materials (website, flagship assets, campaigns).

- Clearly articulate technical differentiation and competitive positioning in a factual, grounded way.

Content Strategy & Creation 

- Own and produce technology- and product-driven content across flagship assets (hero blogs, whitepapers, product pages, decks).

- Translate ongoing technical innovation into concrete, high-quality content that can be used externally by customers, partners, and sales teams.

- Partner with the Design team to shape and produce high-quality product and technology content, including diagrams, visual explanations, demos and videos.

Go-to-Market Foundations (in collaboration) 

- Produce use-case content, value stories, and messaging inputs that Sales Enablement and Marketing actively use in customer conversations and campaigns.

- Collaborate with Sales Enablement to ensure product and technology narratives are translated into clear, consistent sales messaging.

- Support entry into new industries or use cases by clarifying positioning and value stories, without owning sales strategy or execution.

Cross-functional Collaboration 

- Partner closely with Product, Applied Engineering, Sales Enablement, Marketing, and Leadership.

- Act as a bridge between technical teams and market-facing functions.

- Contribute to strategic discussions on positioning, category evolution, and long-term narrative.

Who you are 

Experience & Skills 

- 5+ years of experience in technology marketing, technical product marketing, or market-facing technical roles within B2B or deep-tech companies.

- You combine technical depth with a strong sense for marketing and storytelling, whether you built it in a marketing role or on the technical side.

- Demonstrated ability to deeply understand complex technology platforms and systems, and reason about how they create value in real-world engineering workflows.

- Engineering background (e.g., mechanical, aerospace, or computational engineering) or hands-on familiarity with CAD, CAE, or simulation tools is a strong plus.

- Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to translate technical capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs into clear market positioning.

- Proven ability to structure and maintain coherent messaging and positioning frameworks grounded in technical reality.

- Track record of producing substantial, high-quality marketing content for complex technical products.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt the message to very different audiences, from engineers and technical experts to executives, decision-makers, and non-technical stakeholders.

- Comfortable engaging in technical discussions and asking the right questions to build accurate, credible market narratives.

- Fluent in English, written and spoken.

Ways of working 

- Able to drive complex topics from exploration to execution.

- Able to operate with a high degree of autonomy while staying closely aligned with leadership and peers.

- Execution-oriented, pragmatic, and hands-on.

- Open, direct, and collaborative in working across functions.

- Energized by a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. You adapt quickly, stay ahead of change, and are willing to challenge your own choices and iterate on them.

- Genuine passion for technology, engineering, innovation, and AI. You naturally follow what’s happening in the field, enjoy exploring how new technologies change the way products are designed, and have a strong appetite for learning and continuous improvement.

- Proactive and eager to step in beyond the core scope when projects call for it, contributing to product-related communications such as events, press releases, website updates, or newsletters.

What you get 

- Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence. 

- Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale. 

- Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized. 

- Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another. 

- Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable. 

- Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

MSF International 

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested.

I. CONTEXT 

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent medical humanitarian organisation providing emergency assistance to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters, based solely on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation.

MSF International is the legal entity whose membership is composed of all MSF associations. It hosts the International Secretariat, supports the International Board, facilitates coordination across the MSF movement, and provides shared services and initiatives as mandated by the movement.

Within MSF International, the International Office acts as the Secretariat of the International Board (IB) and operates under the direct management of the International Secretary General (ISG). MSF International also provides administrative and operational support to movement-wide initiatives and services, including MSF Access.

II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB 

The MSF International Managing Director is a senior executive role responsible for institutional leadership, stewardship of resources, and organizational performance of MSF International as a legal entity serving the MSF movement.

The role ensures that MSF International: 

- Effectively implements -within the scope of MSF International - the MSF International Multiyear Plan and SPARC (MSF-wide Strategic Planning, Accountability and Resource Cycle) and supports the International Board and the International Secretary General in their governance roles and responsibilities.

title: Senior RAM Engineer
description:
Destinus Engineering is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Reliability Engineer to ensure that our defense systems and products perform dependably in demanding operational environments. You’ll lead reliability, availability and maintainability (RAM) efforts across Destinus systems and products covering the full product lifecycle, from early design trade studies through qualification, fielding, and sustainment. You will work closely with system design, test, and supply chain teams as well as customers. The ideal candidate is a strong team player with good social and leadership skills to continuously coordinate with the peers of the respective engineering disciplines and teams.

Key Responsibilities 

· Develop and execute reliability program plans in line with contract requirements and applicable standards (e.g., MIL-STD-785, MIL-HDBK-217, MIL-STD-1629, IEC 60812, FIDES, ANSI/GEIA-STD-0009, ASD S3000L or customer-specific equivalents)

· Perform reliability predictions, FMEA/FMECA, fault tree analysis, derating and worst-case analyses, and reliability block diagram modeling

· Define and run reliability test programs, including HALT/HASS, environmental stress screening, accelerated life testing, and reliability growth testing

· Contribute to design reviews (PDR, CDR) and influence design for reliability and maintainability early in development

· Support sustainment engineering, including obsolescence and parts-quality assessments, and supplier reliability oversight

· Prepare reliability documentation and present findings to internal leadership and government customers

· Availability modelling and allocating RAM requirements down from the system to subsystems

· Maintainability analysis plus testability and BIT coverage analysis

· Input to the maintenance and logistic support analysis, working with ILS

Requirements 

Required Qualifications 

· BSc or MSc in engineering (electrical, mechanical, systems, or related)

· [7+] years of reliability engineering experience preferably in the defense sector

· Experience in a tier 1 defense supplier company interacting directly with the military customer is a plus

· Hands-on experience with FMEA/FMECA, reliability prediction, and statistical life data analysis

· Experience with Air Defence and / or Strike systems is a plus

· Experience with modern European RAM standards: IEC 60812, FIDES, ANSI/GEIA-STD-0009, ASD S3000L

· Familiarity with military reliability and environmental standards (e.g., MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461) and DoD acquisition or equivalent processes

· Experience using RWB Isograph or similar RAMS software.

· Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities

· Ability to work autonomously and as part of a fast-paced, dynamic, international and multidisciplinary development team.

· Fluency in English is required; German is a plus.

Details

Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands

About the company 

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Our core expertise lies in 3D vision and graphics technologies which we deploy in a dual-use context for inspection and defence. This role will focus mainly on the defence context where we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Our solutions are aimed to operate with low-cost and widely available sensors and compute. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.

Your role 

You will collaborate closely with our embedded software, systems, and our hardware and forward deployed engineers to design and bring up the PCBs that power the compute and sensor platforms onboard our UAVs — from schematic to flight-ready hardware. You'll set the technical direction for PCB design and hardware bring-up, working with freelance designers and contract manufacturers along the way.

- Designing multi-layer, high-density PCBs from schematic capture through layout and release.

- Routing high-speed digital buses (PCIe Gen3/Gen4, MIPI CSI/DSI, USB 3.x) with proper impedance control and length matching.

- Designing DC power systems for onboard UAV compute and sensor platforms that hold up under LiPo battery voltage sag and EMI from motors and ESCs.

- Bringing up new boards: debugging schematics and circuits, chasing down electrical issues on the bench, and flashing firmware to validate hardware.

- Setting technical direction for PCB design and bring-up across the hardware team.

- Owning hardware from prototype through to a field-ready product.

- 

What we expect from you 

- Senior-level PCB design experience — we'll judge this by the strength and depth of your portfolio rather than a fixed year count.

- Deep experience with multi-layer PCB design and stack-up planning.

- Proven high-speed digital routing experience: PCIe (Gen3/Gen4), MIPI CSI/DSI, USB 3.x — impedance-controlled, length-matched traces on multi-layer boards.

- Experience with DC power filtering and EMI mitigation for battery-powered systems with noisy motor/ESC loads.

- Hands-on PCB bring-up experience: schematic and circuit debugging, bench-level fault-finding, and flashing firmware to validate hardware.

- Proficiency in Altium and/or KiCad, plus a circuit simulation tool.

- A portfolio of PCB projects you've designed and brought up yourself — we will ask to see it.

- Experience designing PCBs for RF/communications or radar applications, ideally with CST Studio Suite or similar EM simulation tools — a big plus, not required.

- Experience with SBC/embedded carrier boards (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson, Rockchip) and camera/sensor interfacing (MIPI CSI cabling, I²C buses) is a plus.

- A willingness to pick up and learn new concepts quickly and to self-acquire missing background knowledge.

- A high degree of autonomy, determination and grit in making cool tech work.

- Full time availability (40 hours)

What we offer 

- Money of course.

- 25 vacation days per year.

- Reimbursed travel expenses and company laptop.

- (Really) flexible working hours — this role is bench- and lab-based, so we do need you on-site, but start/end times are yours to shape.

- Working in an international, world-class team of engineers and entrepreneurs solving real-life problems with amazing technology.

- Large freedom in how you work and implement solutions, project ownership is incredibly important to us.

- The opportunity to take technical risks, to implement stuff the 'right' way and to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops. We are innovating, learning is to be expected.

- Responsibility over the things you build, you are the expert on what you design and bring up.

The application procedure 

- If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us a portfolio of PCB projects you've designed and brought up, along with a resume, website, or other source that gives us a clear impression of your background and skills.

- We'll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we'll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a second focused interview could follow.

- If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we'll discuss the specifics.

- Welcome to the team!

title: Head of Product
description:
Head of Product 

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Location: Delft, the Netherlands (hybrid
Report to: CEO

About the company 

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.

Your role 

As Head of Product, you own our product hands-on. You are the bridge between what the market and our operators need and what we build, turning field feedback and market insight into a clear roadmap and products people actually want to use. You own how our capabilities become real products: how they are shaped, packaged, priced, taken to market, and adopted by the people who use them in the field.

This is a hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves role, not a purely strategic one. You set the product’s direction together with the founders, and you do the work to make it happen: talking to users, writing requirements, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to ship. You bring structure to how we do product without turning it into bureaucracy.

You will work closely with the founders, engineering, and commercial. The company strategy is set with the founders; your job is to own the product within it and make it succeed.

Your responsibilities will include 

• Product strategy & roadmap. Owning the product roadmap and prioritization, and keeping the product direction aligned with the company strategy as the market and the technology evolve.

• Market-to-technical bridge. Translating operator needs, market signals, and partner requirements into clear, well-scoped work for engineering, and translating technical capability back into value the market understands.

• Hands-on product delivery. Writing requirements, shaping features, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to get things shipped and validated.

• Product portfolio. Helping shape how our capabilities in detection, navigation, interception, and beyond fit together as a modular, scalable line-up rather than isolated tools.

• User experience & adoption. Owning how usable our products are for end users: ease of use, onboarding, training, documentation, and the adoption path from first deployment to routine operational use.

• Pricing & business model. Contributing to pricing, packaging, and business models across the product line-up, and owning the product side of the classic marketing mix (the 4Ps).

• Go-to-market. Partnering with commercial and business development on go-to-market for each capability, from positioning and narrative to capability briefs and demos.

• Market intelligence. Keeping an eye on the market: trends, competitors, adjacent opportunities, and where the next product bets should be.

• Regulatory & compliance awareness. Given the defence context, factoring export control, procurement, and relevant standards into product decisions, working with the right internal and external stakeholders.

• Lightweight product practices. Bringing just enough structure, process, and documentation to make product work repeatable, suited to a fast-moving deep-tech company.

What you will deliver in your first year 

• A clear, documented product roadmap, aligned with the founders and understood across the company.

• A working feedback loop that turns field and operational insight into product decisions.

• Well-scoped, prioritized work flowing to engineering, with product shipped and validated with users.

• Input into pricing and business-model choices for the core product lines.

• A joint go-to-market plan with commercial for at least one capability, taken through to execution.

• Measurable improvement in product adoption and usability through better onboarding, documentation, and training for operators and partners.

• A working market map that informs the next set of product bets.

What we expect from you 

• 5+ years in product management, with a track record of owning a product’s roadmap and shipping it in a technical product environment.

• Experience in a startup or scale-up environment: comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and wearing several hats.

• A strong bridge-builder: you connect customers and market reality to engineering, and you are comfortable in deeply technical conversations without being the engineer yourself.

• A genuinely hands-on mindset: you want to talk to users, write requirements, and work day-to-day with engineering, not only set direction from a distance.

• Exposure to pricing, packaging, and business-model decisions (the product side of the 4Ps).

• Experience working with commercial teams on go-to-market.

• A user-obsessed attitude: you care about adoption, usability, training, and documentation, not only features.

• The ability to read a market, spot trends, and turn them into concrete product opportunities.

• Strong communication and stakeholder skills, from the field and the shop floor to founders, partners, and government stakeholders.

Nice to have 

• Domain experience in defence, drones/UAV, aerospace, or other dual-use or high-stakes technology. A real plus, but not a must.

• Experience navigating regulated environments and their impact on product, such as export control, procurement, certification, or standards.

• Experience as an early or first dedicated product hire, setting up lightweight product practices from scratch.

We know this exact combination is rare. If you have a strong track record of building products that reached real users, and the hands-on drive and judgment to navigate the rest, we want to talk.

What we offer 

• The chance to own the product of a deep-tech defence company from an early stage, working directly with the founders.

• Equity participation. We want the people building the company to share in it.

• Competitive compensation.

• 25 vacation days per year.

description:
WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP 

Details

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: Full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months

Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands

About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced onboard UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers who are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members come from different backgrounds such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics, and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub on the TU Delft campus in the Faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low-TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.

The project 

Sensor calibration is a manual job today, and it does not scale to the number of sensor units we intend to ship. We are building automated test and calibration infrastructure to fix that, starting with a cell built around a UFactory UF850 robotic arm on a linear rail.

We already have the arm and the calibration software. What we do not have is the physical cell around it, or the software that drives it. This first project is split into two internships that run side by side:

• Robot programming and automation — this position

• Mechanical design and integration — separate posting

The two interns will work closely together. Neither half of this project is any good on its own. This calibration cell is the first thing we are building on this front, not the last, so there is a good chance the right person carries on to other robotics and automation projects once it is running.

Your role 

If you are the kind of person who is not satisfied until an automated system actually works reliably, not just once, this internship is designed for you.

We are looking for a Robot Programming & Automation Intern to help build the software behind our robotic test and automation infrastructure. Your first project is turning a robotic arm on a linear rail into a system that reliably captures good calibration data — but the skills involved are the same ones we’ll lean on for whatever we automate next: getting a robot to move well, knowing whether the data it’s collecting is any good, and building something solid enough to run unattended.

Getting that right is the substance of this internship, on this project and on whatever comes after it.

What you’ll do 

• Build the robot control layer: drive the arm through its SDK, coordinate the linear rail, and plan safe motion inside a cell that also has a target, cables, and an operator in it.

• Design pose generation that’s actually informed by the calibration problem, including getting proper coverage across a multi-camera rig rather than just one lens at a time.

• Get the timing and synchronisation right between the robot, the cameras, and the captured data — this is where automated rigs usually go wrong.

• Gate data quality at capture time, and retry within the run rather than finding out later that a dataset is unusable.

• Close the loop with our existing calibration pipeline: feed it data, read back its results, and use that to decide what to capture next and when a run is done.

• Package captures with the metadata needed to make a calibration reproducible, and make the whole thing robust to failures mid-run.

• Build a simple operator-facing workflow: mount the rig, pick a profile, press go.

• Work closely with the mechanical intern — your requirements shape their fixture design, and their measurements shape your motion limits.

Who you are 

• You are enrolled in a relevant study program (Robotics, Computer Science, Computational Science and Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace, Electrical Engineering, or similar).

• You are strong in Python. C++ is a plus.

• You are comfortable with 3D geometry: rigid transforms, rotation representations, coordinate frames, and keeping your conventions straight when it is 6pm and nothing lines up.

• You are interested in robot programming specifically — motion, reachability, collisions, repeatability — and not only in the vision maths around it.

• You understand enough about how camera calibration works to reason about what makes a dataset good or useless. You do not need to be able to write the solver.

• You have worked with real sensors and real robots, and you have learned that they lie about timing.

• You care about reliability. An automated process that works four times out of five is not automated.

• You write code that another engineer can pick up and extend.

• You are comfortable taking responsibility for software that moves physical hardware.

• You are independent, curious, organized, and resourceful.

• Linux does not scare you, and neither does a robot that moves the moment your code says move.

We care much more about what you have built and made work than about grades.

Nice to have 

These are strong pluses, but not strict requirements:

• ROS 2, MoveIt 2, tf2, and motion planning in practice

• Experience with industrial or collaborative arm SDKs (UFactory / xArm, UR, Franka), or motion control more generally

• Hands-on camera calibration experience: OpenCV, Kalibr, ChArUco or AprilTag targets, hand-eye calibration

• Multi-camera rigs, and the specific pain of calibrating cameras with little or no overlapping field of view

• Machine vision cameras: triggering and synchronisation, GenICam, exposure control, rolling versus global shutter

• Coverage or observability reasoning: understanding why some poses inform a parameter and others do not

• Simulation environments (Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo)

• Docker, CI, and the habit of writing tests before you need them

• Experience turning a research script into something an operator can actually use

Please include 

When applying, please include links, repositories, or writeups that show us you build things that work. For example:

• GitHub repositories, with a note on which parts you actually wrote

• robot arm or robot motion projects

• camera calibration, multi-view geometry, SLAM, or structure-from-motion work

• data capture pipelines, test automation, or anything that had to run unattended

• computer vision projects

• simulation work

• a short writeup of something that broke and how you found the cause

• anything that demonstrates hands-on technical ownership

If you have ever chased a calibration error you couldn’t explain, eventually traced it to a timestamp, and fixed it properly, you’ll probably fit right in.

Requirements 

• Enrolled in a relevant study program (Robotics, Computer Science, CSE, Mechatronics, Aerospace, Electrical Engineering, or similar)

• Strong programming skills, Python at minimum

• Comfortable working in Linux

• Strong interest in robotics, automation, computer vision, or perception

• English proficiency

• Organized and proactive working style

What we offer 

• 1000 euro monthly compensation

• 10 vacation days during the internship period

• Flexible working hours and the option to work from home 2 days per week where practical

• A direct and significant influence on highly innovative products

• The opportunity to work close to the hardware and the product, with fast iteration and tight feedback loops

• Full ownership of a self-contained system that the rest of the company will depend on

• A team environment where practical experimentation, learning, and ownership are expected

The application procedure 

• If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself. This can be a resume, website, portfolio, or any other source that gives us a clear impression of your background, technical skills, and hands-on experience.

title: Account Executive  - DACH
description:
About the Role

We're building the sales engine for Tellent HR in the DACH market, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us do it. Think of it as joining a startup inside a scale-up.

First and foremost, this is a hands-on selling role. You'll own the full sales cycle for Tellent HR (Manage and/or Grow), split roughly 80/20 between new business and expansion into our existing customer base. Inbound isn't going to be your main pipeline driver, so expect to spend around 50% of your time prospecting, against ambitious daily and weekly activity targets. Alongside that, you'll help us work out how we win in DACH: testing motions fast and doubling down on what drives revenue.

You'll work with a dedicated Product Marketing Manager and Customer Success Manager in the Tellent HR squad. CS capacity is limited, though, so you'll run deals independently, including demos and follow-through.

Your 12-Month Journey

- First 3 months: Learn Tellent HR, our ideal customers and the competitive landscape in DACH. Build your first pipeline through outbound, establish a consistent daily activity rhythm, and close your first deals.

- Within 6 months: Consistently hit your activity, pipeline and revenue targets, understand which sales motions work best in the DACH market, and feed insights back to Product Marketing and Product.

- After 1 year: Be the go-to expert on selling Tellent HR in DACH, with a repeatable, data-backed playbook that others can pick up.

What You'll Be Doing

- Own the full sales cycle, independently: Run 1–3 month, multi-stakeholder deals involving HR leaders, founders/CEOs and Finance, from first touch through to close and follow-through.

- Hunt for new pipeline (around 50% of your time): Prospect by phone, email and LinkedIn, consistently hit your daily and weekly activity targets, and maintain 3–4x pipeline coverage. Partner, CS and marketing leads are a bonus, not the plan.

- Drive expansion: Prospect into existing Tellent customers to cross-sell and upsell, e.g. Recruitee customers adding Tellent HR, or Manage customers adding Grow.

- Sell on value: Run consultative discovery and tailored demos, position on business outcomes, and handle objections, including against key competitors (with support from PMM).

- Manage deals with discipline: Use mutual action plans, keep HubSpot accurate (including SPICED), forecast reliably and disqualify early.

- Test and build, alongside selling: Experiment with sales motions, sequences and verticals, help build the playbook with our PMM, and bring customer and competitive insights from the DACH market back to Product and Marketing.

What You Bring

- Early-stage DNA: You've sold in a startup or early scale-up and built pipeline and processes where none existed. You know what it means to be an early sales hire.

- Proven hunter: A track record of self-generating pipeline through outbound and consistently hitting ambitious activity targets. You genuinely enjoy picking up the phone and creating opportunities from scratch.

- B2B SaaS sales experience: You've closed new business (ideally expansion too) as a fully autonomous AE in a startup or early scale-up, running 1–5 month, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. HR tech experience is a plus, not essential.

- Self-sufficient and resilient: You don't wait for leads, support teams or perfect processes. You bounce back from rejection and stay disciplined through the ups and downs of building something new.

- Consultative and data-driven: Strong discovery, demo and negotiation skills. You anchor on value before price and know your numbers (pipeline, conversion, win rate and cycle time).

- Languages: Fluent English and native or fluent German are required. You'll be responsible for engaging customers and building relationships across the DACH market.

This role probably isn't for you if you want a structured environment with large support teams and steady inbound, or you're more excited by GTM strategy than by picking up the phone every day.

How We Measure Success

- Closed-won revenue against target (primary KPI)

- Daily and weekly outbound activity targets (key leading indicator, especially early on)

- Self-generated pipeline and coverage

- Win rate, deal velocity and forecast accuracy

- Contributions to the playbook

What We Offer

- Compensation: €55000–€70000 gross annual base salary, plus commission .

- Ownership and impact: Real autonomy to shape the sales motion, playbook and market strategy for a growing product line.

- Hybrid working: Work from our canal-side Amsterdam office 2–3 days per week.

- International environment: Join a diverse and international team working across multiple markets.

- Learning & Development: €1,500 annual learning budget and 2 dedicated learning days.

- Pension & Wellness: Pension plan and wellness perks.

- Time Off: 28 paid holiday days, plus 2 additional days in 2026.

- Work from Anywhere: Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year.

- Commuting: Commuting and travel reimbursement.

- Home Office: €200 home office budget and a work-from-home allowance.

- Equipment: Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed.

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. title: Lead Java Software Engineer (v/m/x)
location: Capelle aan den IJssel, Zuid-Holland, Nederland
description:
Bouw mee aan de digitale toekomst van de openbare ruimte 

Bij Progresity ontwikkelen we software die gemeenten helpt om de openbare ruimte slimmer, veiliger en duurzamer te beheren. Onze applicatie BinnenBeter verbindt inwoners en gemeenten: via de BuitenBeter app kunnen inwoners eenvoudig meldingen doen van problemen in de openbare ruimte, van kapotte straatverlichting tot zwerfafval of een losliggende stoeptegel. Gemeenten ontvangen deze meldingen in BinnenBeter en kunnen ze efficiënt opvolgen, zodat elke melding leidt tot een zichtbare verbetering in de leefomgeving. Zo zorgen we samen voor schonere, veiligere en beter onderhouden steden voor miljoenen inwoners in Nederland.

We staan aan de vooravond van een belangrijke volgende stap. Niet alleen ontwikkelen we onze software verder, ook professionaliseren we de manier waarop we software bouwen. We willen groeien naar een moderne engineeringorganisatie waarin eigenaarschap, kwaliteit, automatisering en continu verbeteren centraal staan.

Daarom zoeken we een Lead Software Engineer (Java) die niet alleen technisch sterk is, maar ook energie krijgt van het verder brengen van een engineeringteam. Iemand die verder kijkt dan de code van vandaag, een duidelijke technische visie kan ontwikkelen en anderen weet mee te nemen in verandering. Die begrijpt dat goede software niet alleen draait om technologie, maar ook om samenwerking, vakmanschap en het maken van de juiste keuzes.

Jouw rol 

Als Lead Software Engineer (Java) combineer je hands-on software engineering met technisch leiderschap. Je werkt binnen een multidisciplinair productteam aan de verdere ontwikkeling van BinnenBeter en neemt het voortouw in de technische richting en professionalisering van Engineering.

Je bent eigenaar van de technische visie en architectuur van het product. Je bepaalt samen met je collega's hoe we onze software toekomstbestendig houden en vertaalt technische ambities naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarbij kijk je verder dan nieuwe functionaliteiten: ook onderhoudbaarheid, schaalbaarheid, security, betrouwbaarheid en technische schuld krijgen structureel aandacht.

Tegelijkertijd ben je een belangrijke kartrekker in het verbeteren van onze manier van werken. Hoe kunnen we sneller en betrouwbaarder releasen? Hoe maken we geautomatiseerd testen en CI/CD vanzelfsprekend? Hoe zorgen we dat engineers verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor hun software, ook nadat deze in productie staat?

Je hoeft deze uitdagingen niet alleen op te lossen. Je coacht Software Engineers, stimuleert eigenaarschap en zorgt dat technische kennis en verantwoordelijkheden niet bij één persoon blijven liggen.

Je gaat onder andere aan de slag met:

- Het ontwikkelen, uitdragen en bewaken van de technische visie en softwarearchitectuur van BinnenBeter.

- Het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van robuuste, onderhoudbare en schaalbare software met Java en Spring Boot.

- Het richting geven aan belangrijke technische keuzes en het ontwikkelen en borgen van engineeringstandaarden en architectuurprincipes.

- Het vertalen van relevante wet- en regelgeving en beveiligingseisen naar concrete technische richtlijnen.

- Het verbeteren van onze engineeringpraktijken, waaronder CI/CD, testautomatisering, observability en DevOps.

- Het inzichtelijk maken en structureel aanpakken van technische schuld, kwetsbaarheden en andere technische risico's.

- Het ontwikkelen en realiseren van een technische verbeteragenda, samen met het engineeringteam.

- Het coachen van Software Engineers en stimuleren van zelfstandigheid, kennisdeling en technisch eigenaarschap.

- Het versterken van de samenwerking tussen Engineering, Product, UX, Quality en Cloud/Platform.

- Het onderzoeken van nieuwe technologieën en werkwijzen, waaronder AI, die onze software of manier van ontwikkelen daadwerkelijk beter maken.

Wat neem je mee? 

We zoeken een ervaren Software Engineer die inhoudelijk sterk is, maar ook begrijpt dat technisch leiderschap meer vraagt dan het maken van goede technische keuzes.

Je kunt complexe vraagstukken analyseren en een duidelijke richting bepalen. Tegelijkertijd weet je anderen daarin mee te nemen, sta je open voor andere perspectieven en haal je voldoening uit het ontwikkelen van collega's.

Wat we belangrijk vinden: 

- Ruime ervaring met Java en Spring Boot en een sterke achtergrond in professionele software engineering.

- Ervaring met softwarearchitectuur, REST API's en het ontwerpen van onderhoudbare en schaalbare applicaties.

- Je kunt complexe technische vraagstukken doorgronden, alternatieven afwegen en onderbouwde technische keuzes maken.

- Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen of verbeteren van technische standaarden, architectuurprincipes en engineeringpraktijken.

- Je hebt kennis van moderne softwareontwikkeling, waaronder CI/CD, geautomatiseerd testen, security en observability.

- Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden of coachen van andere Software Engineers en vindt het leuk om collega's technisch verder te helpen.

- Je communiceert helder, kunt technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk uitleggen en weet verschillende disciplines met elkaar te verbinden.

- Je neemt initiatief, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet ideeën om te zetten in concrete verbeteringen.

- Je bent pragmatisch en kunt een goede balans vinden tussen technische kwaliteit, ontwikkelsnelheid en klantwaarde.

- Je bent beschikbaar voor 32, 36 of 40 uur per week.

Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste: 

- Ervaring met Angular en TypeScript.

- Ervaring met WildFly, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes of vergelijkbare technologieën.

- Ervaring met het begeleiden van technische veranderingen of het professionaliseren van een engineeringteam.

- Ervaring met cloud-native architecturen, DevOps en het beheren van software in productie.

Je hoeft niet eerder de functietitel Lead Software Engineer te hebben gehad. Misschien ben je nu Senior Software Engineer of Software Architect en merk je dat je steeds vaker technische richting geeft, collega's begeleidt en verbeteringen initieert. Als je klaar bent om daarin een volgende stap te zetten, gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

Dan bieden wij jou 

- Een salaris tussen €4.500,- en €6.690,- bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van jouw ervaring.

- Een rol waarin je daadwerkelijk invloed hebt op de technische richting van onze software en de ontwikkeling van Engineering.

- Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, technische verbeteringen en het toepassen van nieuwe technologieën.

- Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden en een modern kantoor in Capelle aan den IJssel.

- Werken in een team waar jouw ideeën daadwerkelijk worden gehoord.

- 8% vakantiegeld.

- 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen bij te kopen.

- Laptop van de zaak.

- Goede pensioenregeling en collectieve bonus.

- Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.

- Een rol waarin jouw werk iedere dag maatschappelijke impact heeft.

Over Progresity 

Progresity is onderdeel van de Conxillium Group. Samen ontwikkelen we slimme software voor gemeenten. Onze producten ondersteunen gemeenten bij het beheren van de openbare ruimte: van bomen en groenvoorzieningen tot wegen, verlichting en meldingen van inwoners.

We bevinden ons in een interessante fase. We groeien van een traditionele softwareorganisatie naar productgerichte teams waarin eigenaarschap, samenwerking en continu verbeteren centraal staan. Dat betekent dat developers bij ons niet alleen meedenken over hoe we software bouwen, maar ook over waarom we iets bouwen en welke waarde dat oplevert voor onze gebruikers.

Je komt terecht in een hecht team waarin vakmanschap, nieuwsgierigheid en elkaar helpen belangrijker zijn dan hiërarchie. We geloven dat de beste ideeën ontstaan wanneer mensen verantwoordelijkheid krijgen en samen blijven leren.

Lees meer over onze organisatie op: www.progresity.com .

Sollicitatieproces 

Ons sollicitatieproces bestaat meestal uit drie gesprekken. We vinden het belangrijk dat we elkaar goed leren kennen. Naast jouw technische kennis zijn we vooral benieuwd hoe jij samenwerkt, hoe je naar softwareontwikkeling kijkt en hoe jij jezelf én een team verder helpt groeien.

Enthousiast? 

Wil jij bijdragen aan slimmere, veiligere en duurzamere software voor gemeenten én meebouwen aan de volgende stap van onze engineeringorganisatie? Reageer dan via de sollicitatiebutton of neem contact op met onze recruiter Steven Kruis via 06 57 43 92 61 of

title: Agent Security Engineer
description:
Belmont Lavan is hiring an Agent Security Engineer to secure autonomous AI agents before and after they reach production. Agents now call tools, hold credentials and act on live systems, so they need the controls we already expect for people and services: identity, least-privilege access, monitoring and testing.

You will sit between AI engineering and security. You will design the guardrails, attack the systems yourself, and build the governance controls that let the business deploy agents with confidence.

Requirements 

- 5+ years in security engineering (AppSec, cloud security, IAM or offensive security), with at least 1 year securing LLM or agent-based systems
- Hands-on knowledge of LLM attack techniques: prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration via tools, RAG poisoning
- Experience designing identity and access controls: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, token exchange, workload identity, secrets management
- Working knowledge of agent frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI or Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Strong coding skills in Python, plus one of Go, TypeScript or Rust
- Cloud security on AWS, Azure or GCP, including logging, detection and policy-as-code (e.g. OPA / Cedar)
- Ability to explain AI risk clearly to engineers, risk teams and executives

Over WPP Media 

WPP Media is een dochteronderneming van WPP, het wereldwijde advertisingconglomeraat. We ondersteunen toonaangevende mediabureaus zoals Wavemaker, Mindshare en EssenceMediacom. Binnen WPP Media zijn verschillende centrale activiteiten ondergebracht, waaronder StudioM, Digital Data Hub, Business Intelligence, Proces Management, Marketing Services & Insights, Trading en Quality Management.

WPP Media is een dynamische, jonge en ambitieuze organisatie met duizenden (young) professionals wereldwijd. In Nederland hebben we kantoren in Amsterdam, Eindhoven en Sittard. Daar werken honderden collega’s voor toonaangevende klanten zoals Action, Lamb Weston, NS, Subway, M&M’s, Brabantia, IKEA en Dr. Oetker.

Ons kantoor in Amsterdam biedt een adembenemend uitzicht van 180 graden over de stad en de Amstel. De sfeer is informeel en gezellig, met regelmatig vrijdagmiddagborrels in onze skybar op de negende verdieping.

Over StudioM en de functie 

Je gaat aan de slag bij StudioM, ons interne bureau voor influencer marketing. We voeren campagnes uit op grote, vaak internationale schaal. Je werkt met een breed scala aan klanten, influencers en campagnes, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is.

In deze rol draag je zelfstandig de operationele verantwoordelijkheid voor complexe en omvangrijke projecten. Denk aan multi-marketprojecten, strategische accounts, campagnes voor meerdere merken en innovatieve trajecten.

Wat ga je doen? 

- Projectmanagement: Je bent zelfstandig verantwoordelijk voor het opzetten, uitvoeren en coördineren van influencer marketingcampagnes.

- Planning en voortgang: Je stuurt de dagelijkse uitvoering aan, maakt duidelijke projectplanningen en bewaakt deadlines, afhankelijkheden, prioriteiten en de voortgang van projecten.

- Influencerselectie en briefings: Je vertaalt de kaders en briefings van de accountmanager naar concrete selectielijsten, taken en creatieve briefings, waaronder influencerbriefings. Waar nodig verdeel je taken onder junior collega’s of stagiairs.

- Relatiebeheer en onderhandelingen: Je onderhoudt relaties met influencers en talentbureaus en onderhandelt zelfstandig over marktconforme vergoedingen binnen het vastgestelde budget.

- Budgetbeheer en administratie: Je beheert projectbudgetten en houdt kosten bij, zoals influencer fees, buy-outs en event- en productiekosten. Ook verzorg je contracten en regel je boekingen met bureaus.

- Content en kwaliteit: Je bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van alle content en deliverables, voert eerste contentchecks uit en werkt nauw samen met accountmanagers richting definitieve goedkeuring.

- Afstemming en rapportage: Je werkt samen met interne teams om effectieve campagnes te realiseren. Je houdt klanten, stakeholders en de accountmanager proactief op de hoogte van de dagelijkse voortgang, sluit waar nodig aan bij klantupdates en rapporteert over resultaten en aandachtspunten.

- Risicobeheersing en optimalisatie: Je signaleert risico’s, knelpunten en optimalisatiemogelijkheden, bespreekt deze met de (senior) accountmanager en escaleert tijdig waar nodig. Je stuurt actief bij, optimaliseert lopende campagnes en voert verbeteringen door met medior- en juniorcollega’s.

- Evaluatie en begeleiding: Je levert inhoudelijke input voor projectevaluaties, vertaalt learnings naar verbeteringen voor toekomstige campagnes en begeleidt en werkt stagiairs in binnen het team.

Wat breng je mee? 

- Je hebt een passie voor influencer marketing en leeft social media. Je kijkt liever YouTube en TikTok dan televisie en denkt in Instagram Stories.

- Je volgt de nieuwste features en ontwikkelingen op socialmediaplatformen en weet welke influencers op dit moment relevant zijn.

- Je begrijpt hoe platformen als Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok en Snapchat werken en houdt hun innovaties bij.

- Je bent creatief, maar werkt ook gestructureerd en gecoördineerd.

- Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels vloeiend.

- 5+ jaar ervaring

- Je bent hands-on en zorgt ervoor dat campagnes tot in de puntjes geregeld zijn.

Wat bieden wij? 

Een boeiende baan in een vooruitstrevend en informeel team binnen een van de grootste communicatiegroepen ter wereld. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen in een inspirerende werkomgeving. En natuurlijk werk je met fijne collega’s in ons geweldige kantoor, die iedere werkdag bijzonder maken.

- Salaris: €3.800 - €5.800 (op basis van 38,75 uur per week).

- Toegang tot M Academy: Voor uitgebreide trainingen en workshops in zowel hard als soft skills, inclusief specifieke AI-trainingen.

- Werken voor grote (internationale) merken en klanten.

- Een zelfstandige rol met veel vrijheid.

- De kans om een breder perspectief binnen influencer marketing en social media te ontwikkelen en kennis vanuit de wereld van mediabureaus op te doen.

- Werken binnen een energiek, ambitieus en gezellig team met focus op AI-transformatie.

- Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden en ontwikkelmogelijkheden.

title: Head of Product Experience
description:
At Vio , we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world's fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of travelers find and book the right stay at the right price. They can book with us directly, compare offers across 100+ booking sites, or book through partners who offer our experience under their own brand.

Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence.

With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust.

🔍 Who we're looking for 

We're looking for a senior design leader to own Vio's whole user experience: Product Design, UX Research and Content Design, and the product outcomes they serve. You'll lead a team of around ten across design, research and content. This is a chance to build a function, not inherit one.

You'll report to our Head of Product and sit in domain leadership alongside product, engineering and commercial leaders, shaping strategy from the start. Vio runs two businesses on one platform: our consumer product, and white-label and API products for partners. Your job is to make the experience across both recognisably world-class, and to build a team that can sustain it.

☑️ What you'll do 

- Set the UX vision for Vio's next chapter, and bring product, engineering and commercial partners along with it.

- Own user-facing outcomes with your peers, and make design's contribution measurable.

- Lead Product Design, UX Research and Content Design, and design the org that brings them together in your first 90 days.

- Set and hold the craft bar: run critique and product reviews, and make journeys consistent across our products and brands.

- Work with Product and Engineering on how we ship, not only what we ship: bring design into problem framing early, and raise the quality of what reaches our users.

- Build a team people want to join and stay in: clear ownership, air cover, real growth paths, and recognition for great work.

- Stay close to the work, with ring-fenced time on north-star concepts and cross-product journeys.

- Make AI part of how design, research and content work.

- Give design a stronger voice inside Vio and a visible presence outside it.

🔎 Who you are 

- You've led a multi-discipline UX organisation (design and design systems, research, content) at scale, including leaders of leaders, with real depth across all three, including research.

- You frame the problem before the solution, make trade-offs between user and commercial needs, and can show the outcomes and metrics you've moved with Product.

- You're a credible peer to senior product, engineering and business leaders, and you influence beyond design.

- You've designed B2B2C products, where partners offer the product to their own customers and judge it as well as end users.

- Your own craft holds up at the highest level: you lead critique, set the quality bar in the details, and articulate a vision that others rally behind.

- You build teams that grow, and you hire people stronger than yourself.

- You use AI in your own practice and know how to scale it across a team.

Nice to have: travel, marketplace or OTA experience; multi-brand or white-label design systems; a visible external profile through talks, writing or case studies. 

❓ Why join us now? 

- You'll build Vio's design function and shape its UX from a seat in domain leadership, at a pivotal moment for the company.

- We're one of the fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of millions of travelers each year.

- In 2026, we underwent a company-wide rebrand and launched our first StoryTelling marketing campaign in the UK, establishing Vio as a consumer-facing, creative brand.

- Our mobile apps ( iOS and Android ) have reached 5 million installs with strong customer reviews.

- We reward our employees for the value they create by granting Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

➕ What we offer 

- Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture that promotes knowledge sharing, trust, and transparency.

- A great compensation package, perks, and benefits - including significant stock appreciation rights.

- Flexible time off, with as many holidays as you need, and a chance to work remotely.

- You'll be part of an international team in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam.

- We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden.

- We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins, with company events in Amsterdam and abroad.

- A budget for your home office.

- Access to free mental health support via OpenUp .

We encourage people from all ethnic groups, genders, sexualities, ages, and abilities to apply. If this job description resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you. 

Location: Amsterdam or remote within CET ±1 (some flexibility up to CET ±3 for exceptional candidates), with travel to our Amsterdam office around six times a year.

- The Hiring Process at Vio 

- The journey behind Vio's new brand 

- What we celebrate at Vio

description:
SENIOR G&E EXECUTIVE 

Is organizing truly your passion, and do you know how to turn a client request into a successful and memorable event? We are looking for a Senior G&E Executive to strengthen our team at the Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade & Leonardo Hotel Den Haag Babylon !

WHAT DOES YOUR DAY AS A SENIOR G&E EXECUTIVE LOOK LIKE? 

As a Senior G&E Executive, you are responsible for the organization and coordination of groups and events for Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade & Leonardo Hotel Den Haag Babylon. From the first inquiry until the final evaluation, you make sure every detail is taken care of.

You manage a broad range of meetings, conferences, dinners, group bookings, and special events. With your experience and commercial mindset, you know how to translate clients' wishes into successful events while identifying opportunities to maximize revenue. You work closely with operational departments and are a trusted point of contact for both clients and colleagues.

As a senior member of the team, you take ownership of more complex requests and events, support your colleagues when needed, and contribute to continuously improving our commercial approach and way of working.

A FEW RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Managing groups, meetings, and events from the initial inquiry through to execution and follow-up.

- Maximizing revenue and guest satisfaction by responding quickly to requests, converting inquiries into confirmed business, and identifying upselling opportunities.

- Using your commercial insight to strategically manage pricing, availability, and event planning in line with the hotels' revenue objectives.

- Taking ownership of larger and more complex groups and events and ensuring all agreements and details are communicated accurately.

- Building and maintaining strong relationships with corporate clients, agencies, event planners, and other business partners.

- Ensuring contracts, deposits, cancellations, and invoicing are handled accurately and according to agreed procedures.

- Coordinating menus, packages, room requirements, and additional services while balancing the client's wishes with the commercial opportunities for the hotels.

- Working closely with operational departments to ensure a smooth handover and successful execution of each event.

- Supporting and sharing knowledge with colleagues within the G&E team and contributing to the continuous improvement of processes and commercial performance.

Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade is located in the heart of international The Hague, right next to the green Van Stolkpark. The hotel lies between The Hague city center and Scheveningen beach. Guests can relax in our Promenade Healthclub & Spa or enjoy delicious international dishes at LEO’S International Flavors.

Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade has 178 rooms and features a classic yet modern design, reflected throughout the hotel’s atmosphere. The hotel also offers 10 meeting rooms, making it the perfect choice for both business and leisure guests.

Leonardo Hotel Den Haag Babylon has been an icon at The Hague Central Station since 1978 and is part of Leonardo Hotels. Centrally located, with a fantastic view and all the famous attractions within easy reach, the hotel has 143 rooms and several special meeting rooms. On the first floor of the hotel you will find our bar and restaurant "The Livingroom", where we create a real feeling of home for our guests.

As Leonardo Hotels Benelux, we are part of the larger Leonardo Hotels Group and responsible for all activities for our 28 hotels in the Netherlands and Belgium. At Leonardo Hotels, we care deeply about personal growth, connection, and making an impact together. On average, our colleagues work with us for four years because we always look for good internal career opportunities, and we are quite proud of that!

WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT ADDITION TO OUR TEAM 

- At least 2 to 3 years of relevant experience within Groups & Events, Meeting & Events, or a similar hospitality environment.

- Bachelor-level working and thinking capability (HBO), preferably combined with a hospitality-related education such as Hotel Management or Facility Management.

- Experience with both corporate and social events and confidence in managing larger or more complex bookings.

- Experience with Opera Sales & Catering is strongly preferred.

- Strong command of the Dutch and English languages, both spoken and written.

- A strong commercial mindset and the ability to recognize opportunities to increase conversion and revenue.

- You are organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership and making decisions.

- Professional, service-oriented, and a true team player who enjoys sharing knowledge with colleagues.

- Strong communication and relationship-building skills, enabling you to connect easily with clients and internal stakeholders.

- Strong numerical insight and the ability to think strategically while keeping an eye on the details.

- You remain calm and solution-oriented when plans change, because in events, they sometimes do!

To be considered for this role, applicants must be an EU citizen or hold a valid work permit for the Netherlands. 

WHAT YOU RECEIVE FROM US 

• Travel allowance from 10 kilometers.

• Overtime can be paid out or saved as extra time off.

• Training and development opportunities.

• Clear internal growth opportunities.

• Access to a mental well-being support platform.

• Tax-friendly purchase options through a benefit program.

• Worldwide employee discount programs.

• An introduction experience including an overnight stay, dinner and breakfast.

• The mentioned salary is gross per month and applies to candidates aged 20 and above.

COME SOON TO DRINK COFFEE WITH US! 

Do you see yourself taking the lead in creating successful groups and events for two unique hotels in The Hague? Then we would love to meet you! Send us your resume and motivation and let us know why you would be a great addition to our G&E team.

Geef je carrière een vliegende start 

MVRDV is een wereldwijd gerenommeerd architectuur- en stedenbouwkundig bureau met het hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en kantoren in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. MVRDV werd in 1993 opgericht door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries en zet zich in voor het ontwerpen van innovatieve, maatschappelijk verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft. 

Als stagiair bij MVRDV maak je deel uit van een energiek, internationaal team van meer dan 200 professionals uit ruim 40 verschillende landen. Je doet praktijkervaring op in baanbrekende projecten, werkt samen met toonaangevende architecten en verlegt de grenzen van ontwerp en innovatie. Ben jij gepassioneerd over architectuur en wil je leren in een dynamische en creatieve omgeving? Dan horen we graag van je. 

Let op: We verzoeken recruitmentbureaus vriendelijk om geen ongevraagde kandidaten of profielen voor deze vacature aan te leveren. Wij verzorgen het wervingsproces intern en accepteren geen voorwaarden of vergoedingen met betrekking tot ongevraagde doorverwijzingen. 

Sollicitatieprocedure 

- Je kunt je sollicitatie indienen vanaf nu tot en met 16 november 2026 . 

- De gesprekken vinden plaats tussen 23 november en 11 december 2026 . 

- Succesvolle kandidaten starten op 1 maart 2027 . 

Belangrijk: Om in aanmerking te komen voor deze stage moet je gedurende de volledige stageperiode, van 1 maart 2027 tot en met 31 augustus 2027 , ingeschreven blijven staan aan een daarvoor in aanmerking komende opleiding aan een universiteit of hogeschool. 

Over het Design Collective 

Het Design Collective van MVRDV is verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen van innovatieve en duurzame gebouwen en constructies. We werken aan een breed scala aan projecten, van kleinschalige woningbouw tot grootschalige commerciële en culturele complexen. Bekijk enkele voorbeelden van onze projecten op: https://www.mvrdv.com/projects. 

Het Design Collective richt zich op projecten in de volgende regio’s: 

- Nederland 

- Azië 

- DACH-regio 

- Franstalige landen 

- Noord-Amerika 

- Centraal- en Oost-Europa 

- Taiwan 

- Midden-Oosten 

Over de functie 

Als Architectuurstagiair bij MVRDV kom je terecht in een dynamische omgeving waar gedurfde ideeën en snel schakelen dagelijks centraal staan. Je wordt begeleid door internationaal vooraanstaande ontwerpers bij projecten en prijsvragen en levert een bijdrage aan ambitieuze concepten, gedetailleerde tekeningen en indrukwekkende visualisaties. 

Afhankelijk van jouw profiel en ervaring word je gekoppeld aan specifieke projecten, regio’s en/of projecttypen. 

Dit is een uitstekende kans om je vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen, je creativiteit uit te dagen en een realistisch beeld te krijgen van het werken aan de voorhoede van de architectuur. 

Wat ga je doen? 

- Assisteren bij de ontwikkeling van concepten en ontwerpvoorstellen. 

- Maken van tekeningen, diagrammen en 3D-modellen. 

- Ontwikkelen van visualisaties en presentatiemateriaal voor prijsvragen en opdrachtgevers. 

- Deelnemen aan teamoverleggen en ontwerpbesprekingen. 

- Onderzoek doen naar materialen, locatieomstandigheden en architectonische referenties. 

Wat bieden wij?

Leren van marktleiders

Word onderdeel van een wereldwijd, ambitieus en optimistisch team dat werkt aan architectonische en stedenbouwkundige vraagstukken over de hele wereld. Je werkt samen met professionals uit verschillende disciplines, van ontwerp tot business support. 

Stagevergoeding 

Je ontvangt een aantrekkelijke stagevergoeding van €1.100 per maand , plus een vergoeding voor je woon-werkverkeer (via een NS-Business Card of kilometervergoeding). 

Een levendige werkcultuur 

Ervaar een dynamische en internationale werkomgeving met regelmatige excursies, feesten en teamactiviteiten, waaronder deelname aan de Rotterdam Marathon en andere sportevenementen. 

Gezond en actief blijven

Geniet van betaalbare vegetarische lunches op kantoor (€4,30 per dag), een ruime bijdrage aan je Urban Sports Club-abonnement en toegang tot OpenUp , ons platform voor mentaal welzijn. 

Een inspirerende werkplek

Werk vanuit ons kantoor in de levendige Rotterdamse wijk Blaak , op loopafstand van station Rotterdam Blaak. Een inspirerende omgeving in het hart van de stad. 

Wij zijn op zoek naar een fulltime architectuurstagiair (40 uur per week) die van 1 maart 2027 tot en met 31 augustus 2027 bij ons op kantoor komt werken ( 5 dagen per week op locatie ) voor een uitdagende stageperiode van 6 maanden. 

Meer specifiek zoeken wij studenten met:
