title: Head of Infrastructure
description:
Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications 

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.

As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Head of Infrastructure to own and scale the infrastructure foundation behind this platform.

This is a unique opportunity to lead an infrastructure organization combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads , while building the operational maturity required to support 2x growth .

You will report directly to Sergei, our CTO, and lead the infrastructure organization — owning operational excellence, team development and execution of infrastructure initiatives, while actively contributing to technical strategy and architecture decisions.

Why this role is different 

Most infrastructure leadership roles today focus on managing cloud platforms and abstracted services. Here, you will own the foundations of a real-time, AI-first communication platform — from hardware and networks to telecom systems, distributed services, and operational processes.

Our philosophy is simple: we build and operate our infrastructure ourselves. 100% of our production infrastructure is managed by our teams, giving us full technical ownership, deep system knowledge, and the ability to solve complex challenges without relying on external vendors. This allows us to move faster, make better architectural decisions, and build systems tailored to our needs.

You will work across:

- Telecom infrastructure — we are a global voice carrier powering real-time communications across multiple markets. We manage carrier relationships, routing decisions, and voice traffic flows end-to-end, with the expertise and tooling built internally.

- On-premise infrastructure — around 95% of our production infrastructure runs on our own hardware across several data centers around the Paris and Frankfurt areas, with servers, networking, and connectivity fully managed by our teams.

- Cloud infrastructure — while the majority of our production runs on-premise, we strategically leverage cloud services for remote locations and specific workloads where they provide faster deployment and operational efficiency, particularly for smaller-scale deployments.

- Stateful systems — PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and others powering high-volume workloads.

- Distributed systems — the platform is deployed in a fully redundant way across multiple data centers, with the ability to sustain the loss of a data center without impacting workloads.

- AI infrastructure — GPU workloads and compute infrastructure supporting our AI capabilities.

- Storage system — Ceph provides our main object and volume storage layer, supporting all other services across the infrastructure.

This is infrastructure engineering where reliability, latency, scalability, and operational excellence directly impact the product.

You will not simply maintain existing systems. You will help shape the architecture, processes, and team structure required for the next stage of our growth — taking ownership of critical infrastructure decisions from the ground up.

Your mission 

Your goal is to make infrastructure ready for the next stage of scaling up by building a strong operational foundation across all the infrastructure domains.

You will: 

- Own infrastructure reliability and operations across the whole stack: incident management, monitoring, alerting, post-mortems and prevention of recurring failures.

- Improve operational visibility across infrastructure teams: identify bottlenecks, improve processes and drive continuous improvements.

- Improve capacity planning processes, connecting business growth and infrastructure needs.

- Lead the evolution of our network and telecom infrastructure : topology, connectivity, carrier relationships, routing, redundancy and voice platform performance and reliability.

- Own our on-premise infrastructure operations : data centers, hardware, storage, connectivity and deployment practices.

- Drive scalability and reliability of our stateful infrastructure : PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis and other critical systems.

- Support the evolution of our AI infrastructure , including GPU workloads and compute clusters.

- Drive infrastructure improvements with automation, observability and tooling.

- Partner with engineering teams to ensure applications run reliably on our platforms.

- Lead and grow the Infrastructure team across Networking, SRE, Stateful Systems, Voice, and Data Center squads.

Who we are looking for 

We are not looking for someone who has mastered every infrastructure domain.

We are looking for a strong infrastructure engineer and leader who has built complex systems, understands operational excellence and wants broader ownership.

You might be:

- a Head of Infrastructure looking for a more hands-on technical challenge;

- an Infrastructure Manager who still enjoys engineering;

- a Staff/Principal SRE who has been leading infrastructure beyond their formal title;

- a network or systems engineer who grew into technical leadership.

Must Have 

- Deep expertise in at least 2–3 infrastructure domains, such as:

- networking;

- SRE/reliability;

- database administration;

- telecom/voice infrastructure;

- hardware/on-premise infrastructure.

- Proven experience building and improving infrastructure operations: establishing processes, improving reliability practices, driving incident management and creating effective ways of working across multiple infrastructure domains.

- Experience leading technical teams where different groups own different areas of infrastructure (for example networking, SRE, databases, systems or platform engineering).

- Kubernetes in production.

About You 

You are motivated by complexity and ownership, not titles.

You solve problems before being asked.

You are comfortable with ambiguity — infrastructure is complex, and you know how to make pragmatic technical trade-offs.

You enjoy building teams and scaling impact through people, not only systems.

You stay curious about networking, hardware trends, observability and modern infrastructure practices.

Own infrastructure decisions with real business impact. 

Your work will directly influence reliability, customer experience and engineering velocity.

Build something from an early stage of maturity.

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic leader to build ElevenLabs' public sector business across France. The Public Sector Partnerships Lead will identify and build relationships with government institutions across France, bridging the gap between government and our GTM team to drive adoption of ElevenLabs' products and grow government into a strong, durable revenue stream for the company. The role also involves building strategic partnerships with policymakers, industry associations, and coalitions, as well as monitoring regulatory developments and supporting policy campaigns and impact initiatives.

In this role, you will: 

Drive government adoption and revenue (primary) 

- Identify government partnership opportunities across France — from healthcare and education to transport, public banks, and other state-owned enterprises — and bridge the gap between government institutions and the GTM team to drive adoption and deployment of ElevenLabs' products.

- Build and maintain a wide network of relationships across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs — not limited to regulatory or policy counterparts.

- Promote government adoption of ElevenLabs products and services in partnership with the GTM team.

Build strategic partnerships (secondary) 

- Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, regulators, industry associations, and civil society groups.

- Represent ElevenLabs at conferences and industry events, advancing the company's public policy goals.

Monitor and advise on policy (tertiary) 

- Lead ElevenLabs engagement with government bodies and officials across France, with a focus on AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and/or digital rights.

- Monitor, analyze, and advise on emerging regulations impacting the company — including EU-level developments given France's influence in shaping EU AI policy.

- Support the development of internal policies by our Legal, Safety, Security, and other teams.

- Provide strategic counsel to company leadership on regional policy trends and their business implications.

- Define and implement policy campaigns and impact initiatives that advance company objectives.

Who you are: 

- You're genuinely interested in the future of AI and emerging technologies, bringing curiosity and enthusiasm to your role.

- You stay up-to-date on AI regulation and industry trends, and are eager to apply this expertise to cutting-edge products.

- You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment, working cross-functionally with teams across the organization to support and scale a growing business.

- You're comfortable working independently and handling ambiguity, excelling in situations where you must make informed decisions quickly.

- You bring a proactive, solution-oriented approach to each project, focused on moving the business forward.

What you bring: 

Primary requirements 

- 10+ years' experience in public and private sector (in-house, firm) roles, with a track record of building relationships with government that led to commercial or technology-adoption outcomes — not solely policy or regulatory roles.

- A wide, current network of contacts across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs, including in healthcare, education, and transport. Prior government or grands corps experience is a plus but not required if network breadth is strong.

- Experience identifying and opening doors for technology partnerships with government institutions is strongly preferred.

- Contacts or experience navigating EU institutions or other major European markets is a plus.

Also required 

- Strong knowledge of the French and EU AI policy landscape, including general AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and digital rights.

- Demonstrated success in designing, advocating for, and influencing policy outcomes, as well as coalition building.

- Public policy experience across France.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including when briefing government officials and other policymakers.

- Fluency in English and French.

description:
Ballpoint, c'est 7 consultants à Paris répartis en deux équipes : une équipe attaque pentest / Red Team, et une équipe défense avec le développement de Trapster. Nous sommes certifiés ISO 27001 et en cours de qualification PASSI.

Avec l'IA, notre métier a changé. Trouver une vulnérabilité n'a jamais été aussi accessible : les outils et la technique ne suffisent plus à faire la différence.

Ce qui compte aujourd'hui, c'est de comprendre l'entreprise qu'on attaque : son métier, ses actifs critiques, ce qui la mettrait vraiment à genoux. C'est pour ça que le Red Team est au cœur de ce qu'on fait : un attaquant réaliste, avec de vrais objectifs, face à une organisation et ses vrais enjeux.

Notre raison d'être : faire progresser durablement le niveau de sécurité de nos clients, pas seulement leur lister des failles. 

Nous cherchons donc notre Responsable Pentest / Red Team : la personne qui construira notre pôle Red Team et fera grandir l'équipe.

Nos valeurs

Chez Ballpoint, on accompagne nos clients dans la durée : Red Team, pentest continu, retests. Nos consultants connaissent leur SI autant que leurs enjeux métier, et c’est ce qui guide notre façon de travailler.

1. Curiosité : l'art de creuser au-delà des outils 

Nous cultivons la curiosité insatiable pour explorer des technologies inconnues et décortiquer les métiers de nos cibles, car c’est dans cette compréhension fine que se révèlent les chemins d’attaque les plus pertinents.

2. Chacun fait la différence 

Chez nous, une bonne idée n’a pas de grade. Un script qui fait gagner une demi-journée sur chaque mission, une meilleure façon de présenter un finding au COMEX, une idée d’offre : chacun peut faire évoluer nos méthodes, nos outils et nos offres. Et on attend de chacun qu’il le fasse.

Le poste

Tu prends la responsabilité technique de toutes nos missions offensives, en restant sur le terrain. Rattaché directement au fondateur, tu travailles avec l'équipe pentest / Red Team.

- Porter la qualité des missions : cadrage technique, méthodologie, relecture et validation des rapports avant livraison.

- Mener les opérations Red Team de bout en bout : scénario, infrastructure d'attaque, évasion, débrief au COMEX.

- Rester un pentester actif : web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel, sur une partie significative de ton temps.

- Faire grandir l'équipe : montée en compétence des juniors, parcours de certification, partage des techniques.

- Faire évoluer nos offres et nos outils : pentest continu, templates de rapport, outillage interne, veille.

- Appuyer l'avant-vente : calls techniques avec les prospects et chiffrage des périmètres.

Ton profil

Tu as au moins 5 ans de pentest derrière toi, dont de vraies opérations Red Team, et l'envie de faire progresser une équipe.

Indispensable 

- Solide expérience en compromission Active Directory et en pentest web.

- Opérations Red Team menées en conditions réelles : C2, contournement d'EDR, ingénierie sociale.

- Un français écrit impeccable.

Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day. 

Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritised, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organised, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care. 

Position Purpose 

The Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation will provide senior-level technical expertise to strengthen how health services are organised, managed and delivered, with an initial focus on improving maternal survival and reproductive health outcomes. Drawing on deep clinical experience and specialized expertise in health systems strengthening, systems thinking, and change management, the role leads complex technical initiatives and supports governments and country teams in identifying systemic barriers to quality care, designing and implementing practical improvements, and strengthening the institutional capabilities needed to sustain results.

Reporting to the Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health, the Senior Technical Advisor works across RTSL's technical programmes to translate evidence and programme learning into effective service delivery improvements. The role exercises significant independent technical judgment in developing and adapting implementation approaches, guides multidisciplinary teams and partners through complex health system challenges, and contributes expertise and learning to strengthen RTSL's broader approaches to more proactive, reliable, and accountable health care.

Health Systems and Service Delivery Transformation 

- Apply systems thinking and health systems transformation approaches to identify and address systemic barriers to quality health care, drawing on service delivery assessments and analysis of health system performance.

- Provide strategic and technical advice to national and subnational governments on health system and service delivery reforms, supporting the translation of national policies and priorities into effective service delivery models and implementation approaches.

- Provide expert technical guidance to governments and country teams on redesigning clinical care pathways, referral systems, workflows and service delivery models to improve the quality, reliability and continuity of care.

- Translate findings from maternal death reviews, routine performance data and other sources into prioritised, feasible improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.

- Guide multidisciplinary collaboration with technical specialists across clinical care, digital health, financing and measurement to develop integrated solutions to complex, priority service delivery challenges.

Change Management and Institutional Strengthening 

- Lead the development and adaptation of change management and implementation approaches to enable government and health facility teams to introduce, adapt and sustain improvements in service delivery.

- Provide strategic accompaniment and coaching to strengthen government leadership, management and institutional capabilities, including decision-making processes, performance management, accountability mechanisms and continuous improvement practices.

- Design and guide practical implementation approaches, including change management plans, improvement processes, team-based coaching and mechanisms to address barriers to implementation.

- Promote government ownership and sustainability by embedding improved practices, management routines and accountability processes within existing health systems.

Country Implementation and Technical Support 

- Provide senior technical guidance to country programmes and government partners, supporting the design, implementation and adaptation of health system and service delivery improvements, identifying emerging challenges, and recommending course corrections.

- Work closely with country teams, government counterparts and implementing partners to identify priorities, address operational challenges and support effective programme delivery.

- Document and synthesise implementation experience, developing practical tools, approaches and lessons that can be adapted and applied across countries and other priority health areas.

- Experience using routine performance data, quality improvement methods, and implementation learning to inform technical decisions, assess results, and adapt interventions.

Skills & Abilities

- Proven track record of leading or supporting the implementation of complex health service delivery reforms, including changes to clinical pathways, care models, management practices or health system processes.

title: Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution - Manager
description:
Eight Advisory est un cabinet leader sur le marché du conseil financier et opérationnel, indépendant, spécialisé en Transaction, Restructuration et Transformation d’entreprises.

Nous accompagnons les dirigeants, les actionnaires, les banques et les investisseurs potentiels dans leurs décisions.

En très forte croissance depuis notre création fin 2009, Eight Advisory compte aujourd’hui plus de 1100 collaborateurs dont 129 associés et continue de se développer. Nous sommes présents en France, Belgique, Allemagne, Royaume-Uni, Suisse, Pays-Bas, USA, Espagne, Italie ainsi que dans une trentaine d’autres villes dans le monde à travers notre réseau de cabinets indépendants "Eight International".

L’équipe Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution est spécialisée en évaluation de préjudice et accompagnement sur le volet financier de précontentieux et contentieux en tant qu’expert de partie dans le cadre de procédures amiables, judiciaires, ou arbitrales, mais également en tant que tiers expert.

L’équipe Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution de Eight Advisory, acteur reconnu sur son marché et en fort développement, recherche un futur manager.

En tant que consultant manager, vous aurez l’opportunité d’intervenir sur des dossiers pluridisciplinaires afin de développer vos expertises et des compétences transverses sur nos métiers du conseil.

Au sein d’une équipe à taille humaine, en forte croissance, vous interviendrez sur des missions d’ :

· Evaluation de préjudice et de support aux contentieux à forts enjeux pour nos clients (rupture de relations contractuelles, sinistres industriels, litiges post-acquisition, clauses d’ajustement de prix, responsabilité contractuelle, actions en concurrence déloyale et en contrefaçon, etc.).

· Expertise financière dans le cadre de revue de grands projets industriels (analyse de l’origine de dérapage et appréciation des risques associés) et d’accompagnement de sociétés dans le cadre de leur changement stratégique (préparation de business plan, aide à la décision dans le cadre de changement structurel).

· Investigation financière liée à des problématiques de détournement d’actifs, de manipulation d’états financiers, d’infraction réglementaire etc.

· Analyses de gestion en lien avec une mise en responsabilité du dirigeant en cas de défaillance d’entreprise (analyse de l’origine des difficultés, analyse des flux comptables et financiers, détermination de la date de cessation des paiements, etc.).

· Ingénierie financière liée à des enjeux haut de bilan et des enjeux opérationnels.

Au quotidien, sous la direction des associés du département, vous serez responsable des travaux suivants :

· Conception et réalisation des analyses financières et comptables,

· Rédaction des projets de livrable,

· Animation de la relation avec les différents intervenants présents sur les missions (clients et avocats),

· Encadrement et formation d’une équipe de seniors et d'analystes,

· Gestion des aspects administratifs des dossiers (organisation de la mission, facturation, suivi des heures).

Vos travaux seront adaptés aux besoins de nos clients et auront pour objectif de créer de la valeur dans des situations complexes de précontentieux ou de contentieux. Vous aurez l’occasion :

· De bénéficier d’une diversité d’approches (problématiques financières, juridiques, stratégiques et opérationnelles) ;

· D’être exposé aux clients et aux avocats, et notamment de participer aux réunions de présentation de nos analyses et d’échanges avec les opérationnels ;

· De faire un travail à haute valeur ajoutée pour nos clients.

Vous participerez également à l’identification de nouvelles opportunités et au développement de notre activité (organisation d’évènements, rédaction d’article etc.), et aurez l’opportunité de vous investir sur des projets transverses au sein du cabinet (formation, recrutement, RSE, parrainage des juniors etc.).

Diplômé(e) d’une grande école de commerce ou d'un Master CCA, vous justifiez d’une expérience de 5 à 7 ans en cabinet d’audit et vous vous êtes spécialisé(e) en évaluation de préjudice financier.

Vous êtes doté (e) de solides bases comptables, de qualités analytiques et rédactionnelles avérées, vous maitrisez l’anglais à l’oral comme à l’écrit et idéalement l’espagnol.

Curieux(se), persévérant(e), polyvalent(e), disponible et ambitieux(se), vous savez encadrer des équipes, prendre des initiatives et avez le sens du service client.

title: Staff Product Engineer - AI Native
description:
Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution? 

Vision: 

As a leading software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust is a global company dedicated to offering an integrated suite of legal and governance products. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world's leading Legal Tech company, aiming for a valuation exceeding $1 billion by 2026. 

Our Impact: 

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams in our 8 offices across France, the US, Mexico, MEA, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America, and the Middle East. 

Our Recognition: 

DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the "Happy at Work" and "Tech at Work" labels every year since 2019. 

The Role: 

Lini is DiliTrust's proprietary AI engine, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite. 

We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for a strong Software / Product Engineer, with a focus our platform architecture, to help us bring it to the next level. 

As a Software Engineer work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering. You will contribute to building, improving, and scaling the features that make Lini a reliable and powerful AI layer across the entire DiliTrust suite. 

We are looking for an engineer who writes clean, production-ready code and is comfortable taking ownership of features end-to-end, from technical design to deployment. We also care about how you think about AI: whether you bring genuine curiosity to the product, and whether you can translate a model capability into a great user experience. 

Missions

- Write specifications as the durable asset of the project. Executable acceptance criteria, and — crucially — the non-functional requirements that specs almost never carry: data classification, endpoint × role authorization matrix, volumetry assumptions, latency and throughput budgets. These are the requirements whose later correction is superlinear, so they get decided before generation, not after.

- Freeze the contracts before any fan-out. API schemas, types, module boundaries, invariants. Agents do not negotiate an interface in the hallway: each will make a plausible and incompatible assumption, discovered at integration.

- Pilot coding agents with a tight brief and a bounded context — narrow tasks, defined input and output artifacts, explicit stop conditions and budgets, full traceability of what produced each change.

- Keep producer and verifier separate. You do not sign off alone on generation you piloted, and you act as independent verifier on your peers' slices — with an adversarial brief ("find what breaks against this spec"), never "confirm this looks fine".

- Build the asymmetric gates that make the slice safe at volume — expensive to satisfy, cheap to check: property tests, contract tests, query-count and allocation budgets, execution-plan checks, policy-as-code, backward-compatibility proofs. Written before the implementation exists, so the agent closes the feedback loop itself without consuming human attention.

- Use code reading as a calibration instrument, not as a gate. Sample deliberately, by risk zone, to measure the real defect rate of the generator-plus-gates pair and to keep the team's mental model of its own system alive.

- Keep work-in-progress low. Capped PR size, thin vertical slices, trunk-based with very short branches, feature flags over long-lived branches, CI as the agent's first task rather than its last. More features in flight does not mean faster delivery when the bottleneck is verification.

- Design for blast radius. Reversibility, progressive delivery, structured logs, traces, metrics and instrumentation generated as a matter of course. On many paths, detecting in five minutes beats three days of review that prevents nothing.

Requirements

Being based in France with full working rights. Fluent in French and English. 

Experience & Seniority: 

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion spent building and operating B2B SaaS platforms in production

- Proven ownership of features across their full lifecycle — design, delivery, iteration, maintenance — on long-lived, multi-year products

- Strong background in complex, scalable web architectures, including real modularity: you have seen where coupling stops parallel work dead

AI-Native Practice: 

- Demonstrated, sustained use of coding agents in production work — not autocomplete, but delegated implementation with review and accountability

- A concrete, articulated view of where generated code fails: correlated defects rather than idiosyncratic ones, uniform surface quality that destroys the usual "look here" review signals, plausibility with no author to interrogate

- Comfort being accountable for code you did not author, and the discipline to refuse a change you cannot explain

Verification & Quality: 

- Real fluency in property-based testing, contract testing, and deriving tests from the specification rather than from the code

- Test-data strategy, including maintaining a volumetrically representative dataset as part of the verification apparatus — not a nice-to-have

- Instinct for the difference between a rigorous check and a scalable one: does the cost of checking grow with the volume produced?

Security & Performance (non-negotiable on this role): 

- Authorization modelling in multi-tenant systems, and why declarative, centrally enforced authorization beats reviewing each endpoint. Generated code reliably checks who you are and regularly forgets whether you are allowed 

- Awareness of the attack surface specific to an agent-assisted pipeline: prompt injection through ticket descriptions, code comments and dependency READMEs; supply-chain risk on hallucinated package names; least privilege for non-human identities; and the most frequent risk of all — production data or proprietary code leaking into the development loop

- Performance as a measured number rather than a code-reading opinion: query budgets per HTTP request, N+1, unbounded result sets, missing indexes on new query paths, network calls in loops, execution-plan review. These are invisible at test-data scale and expensive in production

Product & Team Collaboration: 

- Excellent written communication — specification writing is now a core engineering skill on this role, not documentation overhead

- Extensive experience working directly with product managers, designers and stakeholders in a product-oriented setup

- Strong sense of ownership and sound judgment on risk: what to build, what not to build, what residual risk is acceptable and why

Education: 

- Master's degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience in senior SaaS environments

What this role is not

We would rather say it up front:

- It is not a prompt-engineering role, and it is not an ML/LLM research role.

- It is not a role where green tests are sufficient evidence. On security and performance, "the spec is met and the tests pass" is not a weak signal — it is a null one.

- It is not a ticket queue. The profile that shrinks in an AI-native team is the one whose value was implementing assigned tickets between two boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

- Backend: Node.js / TypeScript

- Frontend: Vue.js 3

- Database: PostgreSQL, MariaDB

- DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform

- Cloud: GCP

Engineering apparatus you will use and help build: coding agents orchestrated deterministically in CI, aspect-scoped verification agents (authorization, performance, spec conformance, dependencies), policy-as-code, property-based and contract testing, volumetric test datasets, load and endurance gates on critical paths, feature flags, progressive delivery and end-to-end tracing.

What we offer

- Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment — engineering primarily in Paris, with further engineering presence in Berlin, Montreal and Wilmington (DE), and offices across France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Canada, the USA, Mexico and Dubai;

- Our "Remote Policy" guarantees that you can find the right balance between "Onsite" and "Remote";

- Last but not least, all the day-to-day benefits of the CSE, luncheon vouchers, profit sharing bonuses, etc...

Recruitment process

- Interview with a TA team member (30/45 mins)

- Interview with the Engineering Manager (1h)

- Technical interview (1h30) — two parts: turning an ambiguous requirement into a specification with executable acceptance criteria, then an adversarial review of an agent-generated diff against that specification

- Interview with the CTO (45 mins)

title: Marketing Manager (gn) - More Nutrition Schweiz
description:
Start: ab sofort | Level: Intermediate | Location: Schweiz, remote | Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/Woche) 

In der Rolle als Marketing Manager ( gn ), übernimmst du die Entwicklung und Umsetzung unserer Markenstrategie für More Nutrition in der Schweiz . 

More Nutrition macht bereits 8-stellige Umsätze in der Schweiz, die wir gemeinsam mit dir auf 9-stellige Umsätze ausweiten wollen . 

In dieser Rolle gestaltest du wirkungsvolle Kampagnen, treibst lokale Marketinginitiativen voran und stellst ein konsistentes Markenerlebnis über alle Touchpoints hinweg sicher. Du arbeitest eng mit crossfunktionalen Teams, Agenturen und lokalen Akteuren zusammen, um unsere Präsenz auf dem Schweizer Markt massiv auszubauen. 

Deine Mission bei uns 

- Als Brand Guardian entwickelst und setzt du die Marken strategie für die Schweiz um, indem du globale Leitlinien mit lokalen Consumer Insights verknüpfst 

- Du definierst den Marketing-Aktivierungskalender und leitest die Planung sowie Umsetzung von Omnichannel-Kampagnen (inkl. Massenmedien, Influencer Marketing , TikTok und Point of Sale ) 

- Du gestaltest das lokale Produktportfolio basierend auf den Bedürfnissen und Potenzialen des Schweizer Marktes mit 

- Du briefst und steuerst Agenturen zur Erstellung markenkonformer, lokal relevanter Assets (in Deutsch und Fra nzösisch) und stellst eine termingerechte Kampagnenumsetzung sicher 

- Du trackst Markenmetriken (Awareness, Equity, Engagement) sowie Kampagnen-KPIs und nutzt die se Daten für eine kontinuierliche Optimierung 

- Du arbeitest eng mit crossfunktionalen Teams zusammen, um ein konsistentes Markenerlebnis im D2C-Bereich, Pureplay und am Point of Sale zu garantieren 

- Du stimmst dich eng mit den lokalen Commercial-Teams ab, um die Marketingaktivitäten perfekt auf die Markt- und Vertriebsziele auszurichten 

Deine Erfahrung & Skills 

- Du bringst 4–6 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung als Brand- oder Marketing Manager im FMCG- / Konsumgüterbereich mit. Gerne aus dem Bereich Food & Beverage 

- Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Führung oder Betreuung eine r oder mehrerer Marken in der Schweiz mit Umsätzen von mindestens 50 Mio . CHF 

- Du besitzt fundierte Erfahrung in der Steuerung eines D2C-Business sowie in der Steuerung von Omnichannel-Kampagnen (inkl. Mass Media, Influencer Marketing , Social Media wie TikTok und Meta , sowie Point of Sale + Pureplay ) 

- Du zeichnest dich durch eine starke Hands-on-Mentalität, ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Projektmanagement und echte Lust auf crossfunktionale Zusammenarbeit aus 

- Du hast ein strategisches, kreatives und datengetriebenes Mindset und gehst sicher mit digitalen Marketing-Tools um 

- Du hast verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (Schweizerdeutsch) sowie fließende Französischkenntnisse und nutzt Englisch sicher für unsere interne Kommunikation 

Warum wir? 

Bei The Quality Group arbeiten über 1.200 Menschen mit einer gemeinsamen Mission: Ernährung neu zu denken - gesünder, smarter und mit echtem Mehrwert für die Community. Wir glauben an Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und den Mut, Grenzen zu verschieben. Dabei zählt jeder Beitrag, unabhängig vom Standort oder Bereich.
Je nachdem, wo du bei uns einsteigst, erwarten dich unterschiedliche Benefits, unter anderem:

- Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Produkte von ESN & More

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten

- Zuschüsse zu Mobilität & Fitness (z. B. Wellpass, Deutschlandticket)

- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

- Workation-Optionen und mehr

Im Bewerbungsprozess erfährst du, welche Vorteile dich an deinem Standort konkret erwarten und was es heißt, Teil von TQG zu sein: Ein Unternehmen, das mit Leidenschaft, Qualität und Mut die Zukunft von Ernährung gestaltet.

Über uns 

The Quality Group (TQG) ist ein innovativer Anbieter von Sporternährungsprodukten und vereint seit 2021 die erfolgreichen Marken ESN und More Nutrition. 

ESN ist seit 2004 deutscher Marktführer für Sporternährung und bietet Produkte wie Proteinpulver, Riegel und Supplements, die auf ambitionierte Fitnessziele ausgerichtet sind. More Nutrition, gegründet 2017, steht für gesunde, zuckerreduzierte Ernährungsprodukte und bietet Lösungen für bewusste Ernährung und Gewichtsmanagement – ohne Verzicht. 

Die Vision von TQG ist es, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, die beste Version ihrer selbst zu werden. Mit Leidenschaft und Innovationskraft entwickelt das Unternehmen hochwertige Produkte, die Gesundheit, Leistung und Lebensfreude fördern. Mit einer agilen Unternehmenskultur und spannenden Karrieremöglichkeiten ist TQG nicht nur für Kunden, sondern auch für Mitarbeitende ein starker Partner. 

Das sind wir – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn!

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft oder Identität – bei uns zählt, wer du bist und was du einbringst. Werde Teil unseres Teams und wachse mit uns.

description:
Worum geht es?

Das heisst: Unsere Software muss funktionieren, auch nachts um 3 Uhr. Diese Verantwortung prägt, wie wir entwickeln.

Wir suchen dich als Software Engineer, der unsere Plattform mitträgt. Nicht als weitere Person im Team, sondern als eine tragende Säule in unserem Team.

Über uns

Die EvoSys AG wurde 2011 gegründet und entwickelt seit 2016 eigene Software für Behörden und Organisationen für Rettung und Sicherheit (BORS). Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen in Thun mit 9 Mitarbeitenden und in unserem Markt führend.

Unsere Produkte heissen AlarmHub, Intervento, FloriPlan, AlarmDisplay und SpotPilot. Sie decken den ganzen Ablauf ab, von der Alarmierung bis zur Auswertung nach dem Einsatz. 2028 kommt mit Respondo eine weitere Lösung dazu.

Deine Aufgaben

- Du entwickelst unsere bestehenden Plattformen weiter und setzt neue Funktionen von der Idee bis in den Betrieb um.

- Du prägst unsere Architektur mit. Unsere Kundenbasis wächst stark, und unsere Systeme müssen mitwachsen. Konkret bereiten wir den Schritt auf Kubernetes vor und bauen Dienste so um, dass sie zuverlässig skalieren.

- Du arbeitest an Schnittstellen zu Einsatzzentralen, Partnersystemen und Behördenplattformen.

- Du setzt KI-gestützte Werkzeuge im Entwicklungsalltag ein, so wie wir alle.

- Du nimmst an Code Reviews teil und trägst zu Qualität und Dokumentation bei.

- Du unterstützt bei anspruchsvollen technischen Fragen aus dem Betrieb.

Perspektive

Mit der Zeit kannst du die fachliche Verantwortung für einen Produktbereich übernehmen. Und wenn es für beide Seiten passt, ist längerfristig auch eine technische Führungsrolle denkbar. Solche Rollen besetzen wir aus dem Team heraus. Voraussetzung für diese Stelle ist das aber ausdrücklich nicht.

Deine Aufgaben

- Rund 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von Webanwendungen. Die ersten Jahre hast du hinter dir und arbeitest selbständig, ohne enge Begleitung.

- Erfahrung mit Node.js und Vue.js, dazu Berührungspunkte mit PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux und Git.

- Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge selbstverständlich und kannst beurteilen, wann du ihrem Ergebnis trauen kannst und wann nicht.

- Verständnis dafür, was im Produktivsystem passiert, wenn dein Code dort ankommt.

- Lust, Verantwortung für ein Thema zu übernehmen, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten.

- Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englischverständnis.

- Interesse am Blaulichtumfeld. Eigene Erfahrung in einer Feuerwehr oder im Zivilschutz ist ein Plus, aber keine Bedingung.

Unser Technologiestack

- Node.js, TypeScript, Vue.js

- PostgreSQL und Redis

- Docker - auf dem Weg zu Kubernetes

- Linux, Git, CI/CD-Pipelines

- REST-APIs und Schnittstellen zu Drittsystemen

- KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge

Was dich bei uns erwartet

title: System Identification Engineer
description:
About Us 

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role 

Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles.

As a System Identification Engineer, working out of Lausanne, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust.

Responsibilities 

- Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the .

- Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller.

- Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects.

- Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting.

- Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C.

- New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles.

- Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results.

- Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns.

Candidate Requirements 

- Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree.

- System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data.

- Flight Mechanics & Control: Solid grasp of rigid-body dynamics, aerodynamic forces and moments, non-dimensionalization, stability modes and propulsion models. Also enough control background to know what the model will be used for.

- Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs.

- Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun.

Nice to have 

- Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven.

- Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code.

- Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

- Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality.

- Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models.

- Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

We are building agentic search, where AI systems actively plan, retrieve, evaluate, and refine information rather than simply returning results. As AI becomes the primary interface to the web, this layer will replace the role of traditional search engines.

We are designing these systems to search and reason over web data in real time, under strict latency and reliability constraints. This means solving retrieval, ranking and passage extraction under entirely new access patterns and at significant scale, with systems operating over constantly changing, unstructured data and serving tens of thousands of production workloads 24/7.

Your responsibilities:

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. 

We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

Help us take Wingtra’s new product platforms from fast prototypes to reliable series production. Embedded in the engineering team, you own mechanical design, qualification and industrialization through initial ramp-up. Together we deliver a qualified product, a complete product file and a working production line. We are early adopters of AI and actively build agentic workflows across engineering, from design and test planning to execution and analysis.

Responsibilities 

- 
Take a new aircraft from concept to series production. You work in a small team with electronics designers and test engineers. You get direct feedback from prototypes, flight tests and production builds.

- 
Design and iterate lightweight parts. You design, build and test parts and assemblies, then improve them until they are ready for production.

- 
Choose materials and processes with care. You balance performance, volumes, unit cost, tooling investment and lead times.

- 
Own DFX. You design for manufacturing, assembly, quality, cost and serviceability, and you settle tolerances, interfaces and process constraints early.

- 
Work hand in hand with suppliers. You partner with sourcing on technical feasibility, tooling and part iterations.

- 
Own qualification. You qualify parts with the intended production materials and processes, and you agree product-specific acceptance criteria with the test engineers.

- 
Deliver the production-ready product file. CAD, 2D drawings, tolerances, BOMs, material and process specifications and acceptance criteria.

- 
Hand over a running line. Once the qualification gates have passed and ramp-up is complete, you hand the line and the product file to Production and Production Engineering.

Requirements 

- 
You have several years of experience taking mechanical products through the full lifecycle: prototype, series production and quality monitoring at the customer. Ideally on structurally critical products at volumes of hundreds to a few thousand units.

- 
You are strong in CAD (Solidworks/PDM preferred), tolerance analysis and material selection.

- 
You have practical experience with injection molding as well as additive manufacturing for functional plastic parts.

- 
You prototype fast and pragmatically, then qualify and document with discipline.

- 
You like hands-on work: builds, testing and working with suppliers.

- 
You use AI for design exploration, qualification planning and data analysis. You check its output, share new workflows and keep raising the team’s bar.

- 
You are curious, flexible and collaborative, with a real drive to build the next great thing.

If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

The role:

Operating model and organization

- 
Design the Data & AI operating model (centralized, federated, hub-and-spoke) following Data Mesh principles: roles, responsibilities, domain ownership and governance mechanisms.

- 
Define the organization of the Data & GenAI CoE: scope, service catalogue, skills, sizing and engagement model with business domains.

- 
Design end-to-end processes for demand management, use case prioritization, funding and value tracking.

Architecture and technology choices

Define the target data platform architecture on cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) and Databricks, including GenAI components (RAG, agents, vector stores, LLMOps).

- 
Run make-or-buy analyses and vendor selections: scouting, evaluation criteria, business case, TCO and final recommendation.

- 
Check that architecture, security and data governance choices are consistent with enterprise standards and with the operating model.

Data products: from demand to rollout

- 
Gather and formalize functional requirements with the business, translating them into data products with owners, consumers, SLAs and quality metrics.

- 
Design data products from both a functional angle (use cases, KPIs, impacted processes) and a technical one (data model, pipelines, interfaces, serving layer).

- 
Act as design authority during implementation: review system integrator solutions and oversee quality, progress and risks of the rollout.

Requirements: 

- 
At least 4 years of professional experience in IT.

- 
At least 2 years on projects focused on AI/GenAI, Data Mesh and functional requirements gathering.

- 
Consulting experience, ideally in strategy consulting, combined with experience at a system integrator or delivery firm.

- 
Hands-on experience designing operating models, Data/AI organizations or CoEs.

- 
Experience with make-or-buy analyses, vendor selection or target architecture definition.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Data Mesh and governance: domain ownership, data products, federated governance, data contracts, catalogues and lineage (e.g. Unity Catalog, OpenMetadata, Collibra).

Cloud or Databricks certifications (e.g. Azure Solutions Architect, Databricks Data Engineer or Solutions Architect).

Experience in tech due diligence or post-merger transformation projects.

- 
Prior technical background as an engineer or developer.

International projects on Data Mesh, data platforms and GenAI.

Close collaboration with the Project Lead and a growth path towards programme leadership roles.

title: Senior UX Designer
description:
For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. 

About SkinVision 

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. 

Senior UX Designer at SkinVision 

As a Senior UX Designer, you will be responsible for designing and refining intuitive, engaging, and effective user experiences across SkinVision’s digital products. You will conduct user research, create wireframes and prototypes, and work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure our platform provides the best possible user experience. Your work will directly contribute to making early skin cancer detection accessible and user-friendly. 

Your impact 

- Enhance User Experience: Design seamless, user-friendly interfaces that encourage engagement and retention. 

- Optimize User Flows: Improve onboarding and interaction flows to make early skin cancer detection more intuitive. 

- Data-Driven Design: Leverage user insights and testing to refine and iterate designs for maximum impact. 

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, engineering, and marketing teams to align design with business goals. 

- Drive Innovation: Experiment with new design methodologies to enhance accessibility and engagement in digital healthcare .

What you will do 

User Research & Insights 

- Conduct and analyze user research to understand behaviors, needs, and pain points.

Wireframing, Prototyping, and Design 

- Create wireframes, low/high-fidelity prototypes, and user flows for web and mobile applications. 

- Iterate designs based on user testing and data insights. 

Collaboration & Implementation 

- Work closely with developers to ensure smooth implementation of designs. 

- Participate in product meetings, ensuring UX is a key consideration in feature development. 

Design Strategy & Branding 

- Align design choices with SkinVision’s brand identity and business goals. 

- Maintain design consistency across platforms and devices. 

Usability Testing & Optimization 

- Conduct usability testing sessions to validate and refine designs. 

- Analyze user behavior using heatmaps, analytics, and A/B testing to improve user experience. 

Design Documentation & Systems 

- Maintain UX guidelines, design systems, and component libraries for consistency across products. 

- Document user flows, personas, and interaction models to guide product development. 

We are looking for someone who 

- Thinks User-First: You are deeply committed to designing experiences that prioritize user needs and engagement. 

- Has an Eye for Detail: You ensure that every interaction and visual element is polished and user-friendly. 

- Is Data-Informed: You make design decisions based on user research, testing, and analytics. 

- Loves Problem-Solving: You enjoy tackling UX challenges and iterating to create the best experience possible. 

- Works Well in a Team: You thrive in a collaborative environment, working closely with product, engineering, and marketing teams. 

Essential Skills 

- 6-8 years of UX design experience, preferably in healthtech, SaaS, or native and reach native mobile applications. 

- Strong proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD, or other design tools. 

- Strong proficiency in using tools such as Claude Design, Claude Code, adobe cc, Lovable, or similar. 

- Experience conducting user research and usability testing. 

- Strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, and accessibility principles. 

- Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and translate business goals into effective design solutions. 

- Strong communication and presentation skills for articulating design rationale. 

- Experience or an understanding of design in HealthTech OR experience working in highly regulated product environments. 

Desirable Skills 

- Experience in digital health or medtech.

- Familiarity with analytics tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Hotjar) to inform UX decisions. 

- Experience working with design systems and component libraries.

title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
Senior PHP Backend Developer
description:
About Shiftbase 

At Shiftbase, we build workforce software that helps people get work done. Thousands of teams across Europe rely on our platform every day to plan work, track time, and manage leave, freeing them from unnecessary admin so they can focus on what matters and what sparked their business. 

As we continue to grow in customers, usage and product ambition, the demands on our platform grow with us. Our backend needs to scale in quality, reliability and speed of change . That’s why we’re investing heavily in modernising our platform, building a foundation that allows us to move faster, deliver better experiences, and support the next phase of Shiftbase’s growth. 

About the role: 

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you are a key driver of both product delivery and platform modernisation. You work on the core of our backend, improving reliability, performance and scalability, with the explicit goal of turning Shiftbase from a platform people enjoy into a platform they love. 

You help evolve a mature monolithic codebase into a more modular, testable and future-proof architecture. By modernising the foundation of the product, you directly enable better user experiences, faster iteration and higher overall product quality. 

What you'll do 

Drive technical excellence 

- Design and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions for complex features and system components 

- Make informed architectural decisions that balance pragmatism with long-term vision 

- Set the bar for technical craft through your contributions and code reviews 

- Own complex technical initiatives from design through production, breaking them into testable increments 

Build for reliability and scale 

- Define comprehensive testing strategies for complex features, championing quality within the team 

- Debug and resolve complex issues across multiple components, improving system observability 

- Apply security best practices throughout the development lifecycle 

- Contribute to monitoring, alerting and system health improvements 

Enable team growth 

- Mentor engineers with targeted technical guidance and feedback 

- Support onboarding and enable a collaborative, knowledge-sharing environment 

- Help shape delivery practices and improve team velocity through data-informed decisions 

What we're looking for 

Core technical expertise 

You have deep backend engineering experience with complex, high-scale systems. We don't expect expertise in everything listed below. We value engineers who've built depth and breadth through genuine curiosity and a drive to solve real problems. These are examples of competencies that matter in this role: 

- Modern PHP & architectural patterns : Experience with hexagonal architecture, domain-driven design, or similar patterns that emphasize domain modeling over framework magic. You can build maintainable systems without relying on framework shortcuts. 

- SQL & database design : Comfort writing raw SQL (not just ORM abstractions) and working with complex relational schemas particularly around time-sensitive data like scheduling, timesheets and payroll where integrity and performance are critical. 

- Legacy modernisation experience : You've gradually evolved mature systems rather than pursuing big-bang rewrites. You know when to modernize strategically vs. leaving working code untouched, and understand the balance between progress and stability when serving thousands of customers. 

- Monolith to services : Experience breaking down monoliths with good judgment about when distribution solves real problems (deployment bottlenecks, team autonomy) vs. when it adds unnecessary complexity. 

- Testing in legacy contexts : Practical experience with unit and integration testing, particularly incrementally improving coverage in existing systems. 

This might be your dream job if… 

✅ You enjoy modernising a mature platform and turning legacy code into something you’re proud of 

✅ You get energy from breaking down a monolith and shaping a more modular, service-oriented architecture 

✅ You care about product quality , not just “shipping code”. 

✅ You like improving reliability, performance and developer experience as much as adding new features 

✅ You enjoy working closely with product and frontend to make better technical and product decisions 

This probably isn’t your dream job if… 

⛔️ You only want to work on greenfield projects and avoid legacy systems altogether 

⛔️ You’re uncomfortable refactoring existing code or making incremental improvements 

⛔️ You prefer being handed fully-defined solutions rather than helping shape them 

⛔️ You’re looking for a role where architecture decisions are already “done” 

⛔️ You’d rather optimise locally than care about the end-to-end product experience

title: wo-stage onderzoek milieukosten m.b.v. bestaande afval- en emissiestatistieken
description:

Ben jij die nieuwsgierige onderzoeker die energie krijgt van data, duurzaamheid en nieuwe inzichten?
Wil jij een inhoudelijke bijdrage leveren aan de statistieken van het CBS? 

Dit is jouw uitdaging 

Het kabinet wil dat Nederland in 2050 volledig circulair is. Om te kunnen volgen of we die doelstelling halen, is betrouwbare informatie nodig over onder andere afval en emissies naar water. Het CBS verzamelt en publiceert deze gegevens voor bedrijven. Daarbij maken we vooral gebruik van gegevens uit het elektronisch Milieujaarverslag (e-MJV), aangevuld met enquêtes. 

Naast de hoeveelheid afval en wateremissies brengen we ook de milieukosten van bedrijven in kaart, bijvoorbeeld de kosten voor afvalverwerking en voor het lozen van afvalwater. Hiervoor wordt nu een aparte enquête gebruikt. Maar is dat eigenlijk wel nodig? 

Tijdens je stage onderzoek je of we de milieukosten voor afval en wateremissies kunnen berekenen met gegevens die al beschikbaar zijn. Je combineert bijvoorbeeld gegevens over de hoeveelheid afval en geloosd water met bestaande indicatoren, zoals gemiddelde kosten per ton afval en sectorspecifieke kosten per kubieke meter geloosd water. 

Je gaat onder andere: 

- bestaande data en indicatoren analyseren en beoordelen op bruikbaarheid; 

- onderzoeken welke methode het meest geschikt is om de milieukosten te schatten; 

- een berekening of model ontwikkelen waarmee de kosten kunnen worden afgeleid; 

- de uitkomsten vergelijken met de beschikbare gegevens uit de huidige enquête; 

- onderzoeken hoe betrouwbaar en bruikbaar de schattingen zijn; 

- je bevindingen vertalen naar een concreet advies voor het CBS. 

Met jouw onderzoek willen we bepalen of we meer uit bestaande data kunnen halen en minder hoeven uit te vragen bij bedrijven. Als blijkt dat de milieukosten betrouwbaar kunnen worden berekend, kunnen de uitkomsten bovendien worden gebruikt om de bestaande afval- en waterstatistieken te controleren. 

In het meest gunstige scenario kan de aparte enquête naar milieukosten gedeeltelijk of helemaal vervallen. Dat betekent minder administratieve lasten voor bedrijven, efficiënter gebruik van beschikbare data en mogelijk betrouwbaardere statistieken. 

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag 

We verwelkomen je binnen de sector Leefomgeving bij team Milieu. Met 20 gedreven professionals werken we aan milieu gerelateerde statistieken en doen we onderzoek naar actuele thema’s zoals klimaat(verandering) en circulaire economie. We werken nauw samen met andere teams binnen het CBS. 

We werken hard aan het continu verbeteren van onze statistieken en de cijfers beschikbaar te stellen voor het publiek. Voorbeelden van recente publicaties uit ons team zijn: 

- Bedrijven investeerden in 2024 minder in milieu | CBS 

- Bijna 2 procent meer bedrijfs- en industrieafval in 2021 | CBS 

- Milieukosten en -investeringen van bedrijven | CBS 

Dit breng jij mee 

Je volgt een wo-opleiding milieukunde, economie, technische bestuurskunde, data science of een aanverwante opleiding. 

- Je hebt affiniteit met het onderwerp circulaire economie. 

- Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt complexe vraagstukken gestructureerd onderzoeken en vertalen naar heldere inzichten. 

- Je kunt goed programmeren in R. 

- Je bent sociaal en communicatief vaardig en kunt je ideeën en bevindingen helder overbrengen aan verschillende gesprekspartners. 

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. 

Dit kun je van ons verwachten 

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: 

- jouw competenties in kwantitatieve data-analyse versterkt door gebruik te maken van milieustatistieken en economische databronnen; 

- jouw onderzoeksvaardigheden aanscherpt op het gebied van de circulaire economie en levenscyclusanalyse; 

- jouw programmeervaardigheden in R verder ontwikkelt; 

- ervaring opdoet met het interpreteren van verschillende datasets om betrouwbare profielen op te stellen. 

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

title: Strategy & Operations Lead, Data & Intelligence
description:
GRESB is the global sustainability intelligence standard for real assets. For over 15 years, real estate and infrastructure managers have reported to us, building a dataset of 150,000+ assets across more than 2,000 portfolios. Together with Asset Impact, which tracks emissions for over 300,000 physical assets and 77,000 companies, we’re turning that data into decision-grade intelligence for investors, lenders, index providers and regulators.

We’re building a new Client & Data Intelligence organization to showcase the value of the data to investors and develop new use cases within the ecosystem. It brings sales, product and data teams together under one leader, the Chief Client & Data Intelligence Officer. This role is the person who makes that organization run. The role is based out of Amsterdam.

The Role 

You’ll work directly with the Chief Client & Data Intelligence Officer as the strategist and operator at the center of a newly formed team. Your job is to keep decisions moving, teams connected and priority work getting finished, so the leadership team can focus on clients and growth.

It’s a role for someone who can shape a problem and then see it through. One week you might be building the business case for a new data product; the next you’re tightening the sales pipeline, preparing a board update and unblocking a delivery issue between product and engineering. You’ll move between sales enablement, product and data operations, and you’ll be trusted to run several projects at once without dropping any of them.

You’ll see the whole business, from client conversations to product decisions to the CEO’s agenda, and you’ll have influence over how a new organization works.

What you will do 

Strategy and priority projects 

- Lead the organization’s highest-priority initiatives end to end, for example pricing, our investor program, entry into new markets and maturing the data strategy
- Frame the problem, build the analysis, align stakeholders and drive the work through to a decision and implementation
- Bring a recommendation, not just options
Operating rhythm and decision-making 

- Run the team’s operating cadence: weekly deal desk, fortnightly product council and monthly business review
- Own the decision log, so it’s always clear what was decided, by whom and what happens next
- Spot blockers between sales, product and data teams early and clear them
Commercial operations and sales enablement 

- Own pricing and support deal structuring with the sales team
- Keep pipeline and ARR reporting accurate and trusted, with one view across GRESB
- Work with sales and product to make sure the team has what it needs to showcase the value of the data products
Reporting and communication 

- Build and run the monthly CEO dashboard and KPI reporting
- Prepare senior leadership, board and client materials that are clear, concise and decision-ready
- Act as the Chief Client & Data Intelligence Officer’s point of contact when they’re away

What success looks like 

In your first six months

- The operating rhythm is running and people rely on it
- The decision log is live and used
- There’s one trusted ARR view across GRESB data products
By the end of your first year

- At least two priority projects have been taken from problem to implemented decision
- Leadership and board reporting runs on a predictable monthly cycle with little rework
- Sales, product and data teams describe fewer handoff issues, and escalations get resolved faster
Requirements 

- Around 6–10 years of experience
- A grounding in top-tier management consulting or Big Four advisory, in strategy, sustainability, data or technology
- Ideally, spent time at a sustainability data, ESG ratings, real asset or financial data business
- Strong business acumen and ability to work well in a cross-functional, global environment.
- Experience implementing AI or advanced analytics solutions within a commercial or sales environment.
- Proficiency in CRM, data analytics, and visualization tools.
- A working understanding of how data products are packaged, priced and sold

How you work 

- You think in structure: you can break down an ambiguous problem, find what matters and build a clear path forward
- You finish things. You run several projects at once and see each one through to the end
- You’re organized, detail-oriented and work well in systems
- You write and present clearly, whether it’s a one-page update or a board deck
- You get things done without formal authority, by earning trust across sales, product and engineering
- You’re comfortable moving between the big picture and the detail in the same day
Benefits 

- Involvement in a fast growing international data-driven company
- Opportunity to work with a highly talented and committed team in a supportive environment with strong camaraderie
- Annual leave of 25 days per calendar year
- 2 volunteering days off per year
- Company pension plan
- Free public transport to and from the Amsterdam office
- Free and healthy office lunch catered daily 
- Annual professional development budget
- Home office budget 

About GRESB 

GRESB is the global sustainability intelligence standard for real assets. We transform sustainability data into decision-grade intelligence that drives capital allocation and asset improvement.

Our vision: An investment industry that plays a central role in creating a sustainable world.

Our mission: To provide financial markets with actionable sustainability insights, data, and benchmarks. More than 100 global institutional and financial investors rely on GRESB to help guide their investment decisions, mitigating risk, improving portfolio quality, and driving long-term financial success.

The GRESB team is an energetic group of more than 100 individuals from diverse backgrounds with experience spanning sustainability, data science, software development, real estate, infrastructure, and the capital markets. Most of us work out of our head office in Amsterdam or one of our satellite offices in London, Paris, Berlin, Boston, Singapore, or Sydney. We’re passionate about tackling the sustainability challenge by providing the insights that will power the markets of the future and enable investors to allocate the world’s capital in a more responsible way.

GRESB is a portfolio company of BeyondNetZero, General Atlantic's climate investing platform.

GRESB is an equitable, diverse, and inclusive workplace, one at which all workers - regardless of their gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, sexual orientation, identity, education, or disability - feel valued and respected. We are committed to a non-discriminatory approach to hiring and provide equal opportunity for employment and advancement in all of our teams and programs.
